title.zh: 卷5 帝紀第5 武帝上
title.raw: 卷5 帝紀第5 武帝上 Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wu 1

sentences.zh: 武帝上

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, Part One.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu, Part One.

sentences.zh: 武成二年夏四月，世宗崩，遺詔傳帝位於高祖。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the second year of Wucheng, Emperor Ming died; his final testament transferred the throne to High Ancestor Yuwen Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the second year of Wucheng (561), Emperor Ming died and bequeathed the throne to Yuwen Yong.

sentences.zh: 高祖固讓，百官勸進，乃從之。

translations.literal: High Ancestor Yuwen Yong firmly declined; the hundred officials urged his accession, and he then assented.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Yong refused firmly; the court pressed him to ascend, and he at last accepted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，卽皇帝位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On renyin day he took the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day he ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，改作露門、應門。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, the Lumen and Ying gates were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter the Lumen and Ying gates were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 是歲，齊常山王高演廢其主殷而自立，是為孝昭帝。

translations.literal: That year, Northern Qi's Prince of Changshan, Gao Yan, deposed his lord Yin and established himself; this was Emperor Xiaozhao.
translations.idiomatic: That year Northern Qi's Prince of Changshan, Gao Yan, deposed Emperor Yin and seized the throne as Emperor Xiaozhao.

sentences.zh: 保定元年春正月戊申，詔曰：「寒暑亟周，奄及徂歲，改元命始，國之典章。

translations.literal: First month of spring in the first year of Baoding, day wushen, an edict said: "Cold and heat have swiftly circled; the year is already at its end. To change the era name at the year's beginning is a fundamental statute of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Baoding (561), on wushen day, an edict declared: "Cold and heat have swiftly turned; the old year is upon us. Changing the era name at the year's opening is a fundamental statute of the realm.

sentences.zh: 朕祗承寶圖，宜遵故實。

translations.literal: I reverently receive the imperial inheritance and should follow established precedent.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently hold the imperial mandate and should follow established precedent.

sentences.zh: 可改武成三年為保定元年。

translations.literal: Let the third year of Wucheng be changed to the first year of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Let the third year of Wucheng be renamed the first year of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 嘉號旣新，惠澤宜布，文武百官，各增四級。

translations.literal: Since the auspicious era name is new, beneficent grace should be spread; civil and military officials shall each be advanced four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: With the new auspicious era name, grace should be extended; civil and military officials shall each be promoted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 」以大冢宰、晉國公護為都督中外諸軍事，令五府總於天官。

translations.literal: " The grand chancellor, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs at home and abroad; the five ministries were placed under the celestial official.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Chancellor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was made commander-in-chief of all forces at home and abroad, and the five ministries were consolidated under his office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，祠圓丘。

translations.literal: On gengxu day sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he sacrificed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祠方丘。

translations.literal: On renzi day sacrifice was offered at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day he sacrificed at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，祠感生帝於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Lord of Generated Life was sacrificed to at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he sacrificed to the Lord of Generated Life at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祠太社。

translations.literal: On yimao day sacrifice was offered at the Great Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he sacrificed at the Great Altar of Soil.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，突厥遣使獻其方物。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Turks sent envoys presenting their local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Turkish envoys presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「履端開物，實資元后；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Standing at the year's beginning to open creation truly relies on the primary consort;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Standing at the year's opening to initiate creation truly relies on the primary consort;

sentences.zh: 代終成務，諒惟宰棟。

translations.literal: when one age ends and tasks are completed, surely the chief minister is the pillar.
translations.idiomatic: when one age ends and great tasks are fulfilled, surely the chief minister is the pillar.

sentences.zh: 故周文公以上聖之智，翼彼姬周，爰作六典，用光七百。

translations.literal: Thus Duke Wen of Zhou, with the wisdom of the highest sage, aided the Ji house of Zhou, thereupon made the Six Canons, and thereby glorified seven hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Duke Wen of Zhou, with supreme wisdom, supported the Zhou house, fashioned the Six Canons, and thereby sustained seven hundred years of glory.

sentences.zh: 自茲厥後，代失其緒，俾巍巍之化，歷千祀而莫傳；

translations.literal: From that time onward, generations lost that thread; the lofty transforming rule passed a thousand years without transmission;
translations.idiomatic: From that time onward generations lost the thread; the lofty civilizing order passed a thousand years without transmission;

sentences.zh: 郁郁之風，終百王而永墜。

translations.literal: the rich and elegant style ended after a hundred kings and fell forever.
translations.idiomatic: the rich and elegant style lapsed after a hundred kings and was lost forever.

sentences.zh: 我太祖文皇帝稟純和之氣，挺天縱之英，德配幹元，功侔造化，故能捨末世之弊風，蹈隆周之叡典，誕述百官，厥用允集。

translations.literal: Our Grand Progenitor, the Literary Emperor, received pure and harmonious qi, stood forth with heaven-endowed brilliance, virtue matching the primal yang, merit equal to creation itself—therefore he could abandon the corrupt customs of a decadent age, follow the wise canons of flourishing Zhou, and grandly set forth the hundred offices, thereby gathering all that was fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Our Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai, the Literary Emperor, received pure and harmonious qi and stood forth with heaven-endowed brilliance; his virtue matched the primal yang and his merit rivaled creation itself. He therefore cast off the corrupt customs of a decadent age, restored the wise canons of flourishing Zhou, and grandly established the hundred offices, gathering all that was fitting.

sentences.zh: 所謂乾坤改而重構，豈帝王洪範而已哉。

translations.literal: This is what is meant by heaven and earth changing and being rebuilt anew—not merely the great norm of emperors and kings.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by heaven and earth changing and being rebuilt anew—not merely the great norm of kings and emperors.

sentences.zh: 朕入嗣大寶，思揚休烈。

translations.literal: I have succeeded to the great treasure and think to extend his glorious achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Having succeeded to the great mandate, I mean to extend his glorious achievements.

sentences.zh: 今可班斯禮於太祖廟庭。

translations.literal: Now let this rite be promulgated in the court of the Grand Progenitor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Let this rite now be promulgated in the court of Yuwen Tai's temple.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，祠太廟，班太祖所述六官焉。

translations.literal: " On jisi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple, and the Six Offices set forth by the Grand Progenitor were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: " On jisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple and promulgated the Six Offices established by Yuwen Tai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吐谷渾、高昌並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Tuyuhun and Gaochang both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔先經兵戎官年六十已上，及民七十已上，節級板授官。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day an edict ordered that officials who had previously served in military posts and were sixty or older, and commoners seventy or older, should receive offices by graded appointment on the board.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered that former military officials aged sixty or above and commoners aged seventy or above should receive graded board appointments.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On yihai day he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he performed the ceremonial plowing at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大射於正武殿，賜百官各有差。

translations.literal: On bingzi day a great archery ceremony was held at the Hall of Correct Martiality; officials were rewarded each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he held a great archery ceremony at the Hall of Correct Martiality and rewarded officials according to rank.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，遣大使巡察天下。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao, grand envoys were dispatched to inspect the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on jimao day, grand envoys were dispatched to inspect the realm.

sentences.zh: 於洮陽置洮州。

translations.literal: At Taoyang, Tao Province was established.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Province was established at Taoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the sun was worshipped at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day he worshipped the sun at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙未，突厥、宕昌並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the Turks and Dangchang both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Turkish and Dangchang envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，省轝輦，去百戲。

translations.literal: On bingwu day palanquins and carriages were reduced, and the hundred entertainments were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day palanquins and carriages were cut back and the hundred entertainments were abolished.

sentences.zh: 弘農上言九尾狐見。

translations.literal: Hongnong reported that a nine-tailed fox had appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Hongnong reported the appearance of a nine-tailed fox.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，改八丁兵為十二丁兵，率歲一月役。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin, the eight-ding corvée was changed to twelve-ding corvée, with one month of service per year.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on bingyin day, the eight-ding corvée was changed to twelve-ding corvée, with one month of labor per year.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on the first day, bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以少傅、吳公尉遲綱為大司空。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the junior tutor, Duke of Wu Yuchi Gang, was made grand minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Junior Tutor Yuchi Gang, Duke of Wu, was made grand minister of works.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，白蘭遣使獻犀甲、鐵鎧。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Bailan sent envoys presenting rhinoceros armor and iron mail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Bailan sent envoys presenting rhinoceros-hide armor and iron mail.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，封孝閔皇帝子康為紀國公，皇子贇為魯國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu, the son of Emperor Xiaomin, Kang, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ji state; the imperial son Yun was enfeoffed as Duke of Lu state.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on bingwu day, Emperor Xiaomin's son Kang was enfeoffed as duke of Ji, and the imperial son Yun as duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 晉公護獲玉斗以獻。

translations.literal: Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu obtained a jade dipper and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu obtained a jade dipper and presented it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，突厥、龜茲並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Turks and Kucha both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Turkish and Kuchan envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，遣治御正殷不害等使於陳。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou, Director of Governance Yin Buhai and others were sent as envoys to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yiyou day, Director of Governance Yin Buhai and others were sent as envoys to Chen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，詔曰：「亢旱歷時，嘉苗殄悴。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen, an edict said: "Great drought has persisted for a long time; fine seedlings wither and die.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wushen day, an edict said: "Prolonged drought has withered the good crops.

sentences.zh: 豈獄犴失理，刑罰乖衷歟？

translations.literal: Is it because prisons are unjust and punishments miss the mean?
translations.idiomatic: Are prisons unjust and punishments out of balance?

sentences.zh: 其所在見囚：死以下，一歲刑以上，各降本罪一等；

translations.literal: All prisoners then held: for death and below, and punishments of one year or more, each should have the original offense reduced one grade;
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners then held—for death and below, and for sentences of one year or more—should have their offenses reduced one grade;

sentences.zh: 百鞭以下，悉原免之。

translations.literal: for one hundred lashes and below, all should be fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: for one hundred lashes and below, all should be fully remitted.

sentences.zh: 」更鑄錢，文曰「布泉」，以一當五，與五銖並行。

translations.literal: Coin was recast with the inscription "Buquan," valued at five and circulating alongside the five-zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Coin was recast bearing the inscription "Buquan," valued at five and circulated alongside the five-zhu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，追封皇伯父顥為邵國公，以晉公子江陵公會為後；

translations.literal: On jiyou day the Emperor's elder uncle by the father's line, Hao, was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Shao state; Duke of Jiangling Hui, son of Duke of Jin, was made his heir;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor's elder paternal uncle Hao was posthumously enfeoffed as duke of Shao; Hui, Duke of Jiangling and son of Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, was made his heir;

sentences.zh: 次伯父連為杞國公，以章武孝公子永昌公亮為後；

translations.literal: the next elder uncle, Lian, as Duke of Qi state; Yongchang Duke Liang, son of Duke of Zhangwu Xiao, as his heir;
translations.idiomatic: the next uncle Lian as duke of Qi; Liang, Duke of Yongchang and son of Duke of Zhangwu Xiao, as his heir;

sentences.zh: 第三伯父洛生為莒國公，以晉公子崇業公至為後；

translations.literal: the third elder uncle, Luosheng, as Duke of Ju state; Chongye Duke Zhi, son of Duke of Jin, as his heir;
translations.idiomatic: the third uncle Luosheng as duke of Ju; Zhi, Duke of Chongye and son of Duke of Jin, as his heir;

sentences.zh: 又追封武邑公震為宋國公，以世宗子實為後：並襲封。

translations.literal: also Duke of Wuyi Zhen was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Song state, with Emperor Ming's son Shi as his heir: all received inherited enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wuyi Zhen was also posthumously enfeoffed as duke of Song, with Emperor Ming's son Shi as his heir; all received inherited enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: On jisi day Mars entered the Celestial Chariot, encroaching upon the Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Mars entered the Celestial Chariot and encroached upon the Accumulated Corpses.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，南寧州遣使獻滇馬及蜀鎧。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen, Ningnan Province sent envoys presenting Dian horses and Shu armor.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jiachen day, Ningnan Province sent envoys presenting Dian horses and Shu armor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，客星見於翼。

translations.literal: On yisi day a guest star appeared in Wings.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day a guest star appeared in Wings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，熒惑犯太微上將，合焉。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Mars encroached upon the Grand Marshal in the Supreme Palace and conjoined with it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Mars encroached upon the Grand Marshal in the Supreme Palace and conjoined with it.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，至自岐陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu, he returned from Qiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renwu day, he returned from Qiyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，追封皇族祖仲為虞國公。

translations.literal: That year, the imperial clan ancestor Zhong was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Yu state.
translations.idiomatic: That year the imperial clan ancestor Zhong was posthumously enfeoffed as duke of Yu.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬寅，初於蒲州開河渠，同州開龍首渠，以廣灌溉。

translations.literal: Second year, first month of spring, day renyin, canal works were first opened at Pu Province, and the Longshou canal at Tong Province, to expand irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month of spring, on renyin day, canal works were opened at Pu Province and the Longshou canal at Tong Province to expand irrigation.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以陳主弟頊為柱國，送還江南。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Chen ruler's younger brother Xu was made a pillar-of-state and sent back south of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Chen ruler's younger brother Xu was made a pillar-of-state and escorted back to the south.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，詔柱國以下，帥都督以上，母妻授太夫人、夫人、郡君、縣君各有差。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jichou, an edict ordered that from pillar-of-state downward and commander-in-chief upward, mothers and wives should receive the titles Lady Grand Matron, Lady, Commandery Lady, and County Lady each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on jichou day, an edict ordered that from pillar-of-state down and commander-in-chief up, mothers and wives should receive titles of grand matron, lady, commandery lady, and county lady according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太白入昴。

translations.literal: On guisi day Venus entered the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus entered the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 己亥，柱國、大司馬、涼國公賀蘭祥薨。

translations.literal: On jihai day the pillar-of-state, grand marshal, Duke of Liang Helan Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Pillar-of-State Helan Xiang, grand marshal and Duke of Liang, died.

sentences.zh: 洛州民周共妖言惑衆，假署將相，事發伏誅。

translations.literal: A man of Luo Province, Zhou Gong, used demonic speech to delude the masses, falsely appointing generals and ministers; when the affair was exposed he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Gong of Luo Province used sorcerous speech to delude the people and falsely appointed generals and ministers; when the plot was exposed he was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu, Mars encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renwu day, Mars encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，禁屠宰，旱故也。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen, slaughter was forbidden because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiachen day, slaughter was forbidden because of drought.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，南陽獻三足烏。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Nanyang presented a three-legged crow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Nanyang presented a three-legged crow.

sentences.zh: 湖州上言見二白鹿從三角獸而行。

translations.literal: Huzhou reported seeing two white deer walking with a three-horned beast.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou reported two white deer seen walking with a three-horned beast.

sentences.zh: 己未，於伏流城置和州。

translations.literal: On jiwei day He Province was established at Fuliucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day He Province was established at Fuliucheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔曰：「比以寇難猶梗，九州未一，文武之官立功效者，雖錫以茅土，而未

translations.literal: On guihai day an edict said: "Recently, because bandit troubles still obstruct the realm and the nine provinces are not yet one, civil and military officials who have achieved merit, though enfeoffed with feudal estates, have not yet
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict said: "Because bandit troubles still obstruct the realm and the nine provinces are not yet united, civil and military officials who have achieved merit, though enfeoffed with estates, have not yet

translations.literal: (reached)
translations.idiomatic: (reached)

sentences.zh: 〔給〕租賦。

translations.literal: [been granted] their rent and tax allotments.
translations.idiomatic: [been granted] their rent and tax allotments.

sentences.zh: 諸柱國等勳德隆重，宜有優崇，各准別制，邑戶聽寄食他縣。」

translations.literal: The various pillars-of-state and others have heavy merit and virtue and should receive special honor; each shall follow a separate statute, and fief households may take sustenance from other counties."
translations.idiomatic: The various pillars-of-state and others have weighty merit and should receive special honor; each shall follow a separate statute, and fief households may draw sustenance from other counties."

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，以山南衆瑞並集，大赦天下，百官及軍人，普汎二級。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengwu, because auspicious omens from south of the mountains all gathered together, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire; officials and soldiers were all broadly promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on gengwu day, because auspicious omens from south of the mountains had gathered, a general amnesty was proclaimed; officials and soldiers were all promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 南陽宛縣三足烏所集，免今年役及租賦之半。

translations.literal: Where the three-legged crow of Wannan county in Nanyang had alighted, this year's corvée and half the rent and taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Wannan county, Nanyang, where the three-legged crow had alighted, this year's corvée and half the rent and taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以柱國隨國公楊忠為大司空，吳國公尉遲綱為陝州總管。

translations.literal: On renchen day the pillar-of-state, Duke of Sui Yang Zhong, was made grand minister of works, and Duke of Wu Yuchi Gang was made commander-in-chief of Shan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong, Duke of Sui, was made grand minister of works, and Yuchi Gang, Duke of Wu, was made commander-in-chief of Shan Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以柱國蜀國公尉遲迥為大司馬，邵國公會為蒲州總管。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai, the pillar-of-state, Duke of Shu Yuchi Jiong, was made grand marshal; Duke of Shao Hui was made commander-in-chief of Pu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jihai day, Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, was made grand marshal; Hui, Duke of Shao, was made commander-in-chief of Pu Province.

sentences.zh: 分山南荊州、安州、襄州、江陵為四州總管。

translations.literal: South of the mountains, Jing Province, An Province, Xiang Province, and Jiangling were divided into four provincial command headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: South of the mountains, Jing, An, Xiang, and Jiangling were divided into four provincial command headquarters.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，封開府賀拔緯為霍國公。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi, Opening-the-Feudatory Helba Wei was enfeoffed as Duke of Huo state.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on jisi day, Helba Wei, opening-the-feudatory, was enfeoffed as duke of Huo.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On yihai day Venus encroached upon the Celestial Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus encroached upon the Celestial Chariot.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the first day, wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，詔曰：「樹之元首，君臨海內，本乎宣明教化，亭毒黔黎；

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu, an edict said: "Standing at the head of the tree and ruling within the seas rests fundamentally on spreading and clarifying teaching and transformation, nurturing the black-haired people;
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day, an edict said: "Standing at the head and ruling the realm rests on spreading teaching and nurturing the people;

sentences.zh: 豈唯尊貴其身，侈富其位。

translations.literal: how can it be only to honor oneself and enrich one's position?
translations.idiomatic: it cannot be only to honor oneself and enrich one's rank.

sentences.zh: 是以唐堯疏葛之衣，麤糲之食，尚臨汾陽而永歎，登姑射而興想。

translations.literal: Thus Tang Yao wore coarse hemp and ate coarse grain, yet still sighed forever at Fenyang and was moved to longing when he ascended Guye.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Emperor Yao wore coarse hemp and ate plain food, yet still sighed at Fenyang and was stirred to longing on Mount Guye.

sentences.zh: 況無聖人之德而嗜欲過之，何以克厭衆心，處於尊位，朕甚恧焉。

translations.literal: How much more when one lacks the virtue of a sage yet indulges desires beyond measure—how can one satisfy the hearts of the masses and remain in the honored position? I am deeply ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: How much more when one lacks a sage's virtue yet indulges desires beyond measure—how can one satisfy the people and hold the honored throne? I am deeply ashamed.

sentences.zh: 今巨寇未平，軍戎費廣，百姓空虛，與誰為足。

translations.literal: Now the great bandits are not yet pacified, military expenses are vast, and the common people are destitute—with whom can sufficiency be shared?
translations.idiomatic: Now great enemies are not yet pacified, military costs are vast, and the people are destitute—with whom can I share abundance?

sentences.zh: 凡是供朕衣服飲食，四時所須，爰及宮內調度，朕今手自減削。

translations.literal: All that supplies my clothing and food, what is needed in the four seasons, and even the palace's arrangements—I now personally reduce and cut them.
translations.idiomatic: All that supplies my clothing and food, what is needed through the four seasons, and even the palace's arrangements—I now personally cut back.

sentences.zh: 縱不得頓行古人之道，豈曰全無庶幾。

translations.literal: Though I cannot at once fully follow the way of the ancients, can it be said there is no hope of approximation?
translations.idiomatic: Though I cannot at once fully follow the way of the ancients, can it be said there is no hope of drawing near it?

sentences.zh: 凡爾百司，安得不思省約，勖朕不逮者哉。

translations.literal: All you hundred offices—how can you fail to think of economy and restraint, and encourage me where I fall short?
translations.idiomatic: All you hundred offices—how can you fail to think of thrift and restraint, and help me where I fall short?

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，帝御大武殿大射，公卿列將皆會。

translations.literal: " On xinhai day the Emperor held a great archery ceremony at the Hall of Great Martiality; dukes, ministers, and ranked generals all assembled.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinhai day the emperor held a great archery ceremony at the Hall of Great Martiality; dukes, ministers, and ranked generals all attended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，講武於少陵原。

translations.literal: On wuwu day military exercises were conducted on Shaoling Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day he reviewed troops on Shaoling Plain.

sentences.zh: 分南寧州置恭州。

translations.literal: Gong Province was established from Ningnan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Province was established from Ningnan Province.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以大將軍衛國公直、大將軍趙國公招並為柱國。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao, the grand general, Duke of Wei Zhi, and the grand general, Duke of Zhao Zhao, were both made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on dingmao day, Grand General Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, and Grand General Zhao, Duke of Zhao, were both made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 又以招為益州總管。

translations.literal: Zhao was also made commander-in-chief of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao was also made commander-in-chief of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，熒惑犯歲星於危南。

translations.literal: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Jupiter south of Danger.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Jupiter south of Danger.

sentences.zh: 十二月，益州獻赤烏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Yi Province presented a red crow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, Yi Province presented a red crow.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛未，改光遷國為遷州。

translations.literal: Third year, first month of spring, day xinwei, Guangqian state was changed to Qian Province.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month of spring, on xinwei day, Guangqian state was changed to Qian Province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太保、梁國公侯莫陳崇賜死。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the grand guardian, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Grand Guardian Houmochen Chong, Duke of Liang, was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，於乞銀城置銀州。

translations.literal: On renchen day Yin Province was established at Qiyincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yin Province was established at Qiyincheng.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，初頒新律。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi, the new code was first promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on gengzi day, the new code was first promulgated.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔魏大統九年以前，都督以上身亡而子孫未齒敘者，節級授官。

translations.literal: On xinchou day an edict ordered that before the ninth year of Great Unity of Wei, commanders-in-chief and above who had died while their descendants had not yet received graded appointment should receive offices by graded conferral.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered that before Wei's ninth year of Great Unity, commanders-in-chief and above who had died while their descendants had not yet received graded appointment should receive graded offices.

sentences.zh: 渭州獻三足烏。

translations.literal: Wei Province presented a three-legged crow.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Province presented a three-legged crow.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔曰：「二儀創辟，玄象著明；

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict said: "When the two principles first opened creation, the dark signs were made clear;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict said: "When the two principles first opened creation, the celestial signs were made clear;

sentences.zh: 三才已備，歷數昭列。

translations.literal: when the three powers were complete, the sequence of fate was displayed in order.
translations.idiomatic: when the three powers were complete, the sequence of fate was set forth in order.

sentences.zh: 故《書》稱欽若敬授，《易》序治曆明時。

translations.literal: Thus the 《Documents》 says "reverently accord and respectfully grant," and the 《Changes》 sets forth "regulating the calendar and clarifying the seasons."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Documents says "reverently accord and respectfully grant," and the Changes sets forth "regulating the calendar and clarifying the seasons."

sentences.zh: 此先代一定之典，百王不易之務。

translations.literal: These are the fixed canons of former ages and tasks no hundred kings may change.
translations.idiomatic: These are the fixed canons of former ages and duties no hundred kings may change.

sentences.zh: 伏惟太祖文皇帝，敬順昊天，憂勞庶政，曆序六家，以陰陽為首。

translations.literal: Alas, the Grand Progenitor, the Literary Emperor, reverently followed August Heaven, labored anxiously over the hundred affairs, and ordered the six schools of calendrics, taking yin and yang as foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai, the Literary Emperor, reverently followed August Heaven, labored over the hundred affairs, and ordered the six schools of calendrics, taking yin and yang as foremost.

sentences.zh: 洎予小子，弗克遵行，惟斯不安，夕惕若厲。

translations.literal: When it came to me, the small person, I could not follow and carry it out; only in this was I uneasy, vigilant at evening as if in peril.
translations.idiomatic: When it came to me, the lesser man, I could not follow and carry it out; in this alone I was uneasy, vigilant at evening as if in peril.

sentences.zh: 自頃朝廷權輿，事多倉卒，乖和爽序，違失先志。

translations.literal: Recently, since the court was first established, affairs were mostly hurried; harmony and proper sequence were lost, and the former intent was violated.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, since the court was first established, affairs were mostly hurried; harmony and proper sequence were lost and the former intent violated.

sentences.zh: 致風雨愆時，疾厲屢起，嘉生不遂，萬物不長，朕甚傷之。

translations.literal: This caused wind and rain to miss their seasons, pestilence to arise repeatedly, fine growth to fail, and the myriad things not to flourish—I am deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: This caused wind and rain to miss their seasons, pestilence to arise repeatedly, good growth to fail, and the myriad things not to flourish—I am deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 自今舉大事、行大政，非軍機急速，皆宜依月令，以順天心。」

translations.literal: From now on, whenever great affairs are undertaken or great policies enacted, unless military urgency requires haste, all should follow the monthly ordinances to accord with Heaven's heart."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whenever great affairs are undertaken or great policies enacted, unless military urgency requires haste, all should follow the monthly ordinances to accord with Heaven's heart."

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Third month, first day yichou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on the first day, yichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宕昌遣使獻生猛獸二，詔放之南山。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Dangchang sent envoys presenting two live fierce beasts; an edict ordered them released on South Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Dangchang sent envoys presenting two live fierce beasts; an edict ordered them released on South Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，益州獻三足烏。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Yi Province presented a three-legged crow.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yi Province presented a three-legged crow.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，以柱國、鄭國公達奚武為太保，大將軍韓果為柱國。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei, the pillar-of-state, Duke of Zheng Daxi Wu, was made grand guardian; Grand General Han Guo was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on yiwei day, Pillar-of-State Daxi Wu, Duke of Zheng, was made grand guardian; Grand General Han Guo was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 己亥，帝御正武殿錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Emperor reviewed prisoners at the Hall of Correct Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the emperor reviewed prisoners at the Hall of Correct Martiality.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大雩。

translations.literal: On guimao day a great rain sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day a great rain sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，有牛足生於背。

translations.literal: On guichou day an ox had a hoof growing from its back.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an ox was born with a hoof growing from its back.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸太學，乙太傅、燕國公于謹為三老而問道焉。

translations.literal: On wuwu day he visited the Imperial Academy and honored the grand preceptor, Duke of Yan Yu Jin, as senior elder and questioned him on the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day he visited the Imperial Academy, honored Grand Preceptor Yu Jin, Duke of Yan, as senior elder, and questioned him on the Way.

sentences.zh: 初禁天下報讐，犯者以殺人論。

translations.literal: Private vengeance was first forbidden throughout the empire; offenders were judged as murderers.
translations.idiomatic: Private vengeance was first forbidden throughout the realm; offenders were judged as murderers.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔百官及民庶上封事，極言得失。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered officials and commoners to submit sealed memorials, speaking to the utmost of gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered officials and commoners to submit sealed memorials speaking freely of gain and loss.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子朔，避正寢不受朝，旱故也。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day jiazi, he avoided the main chamber and did not hold audience because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on the first day, jiazi, he avoided the main chamber and did not hold audience because of drought.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day rain fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，行幸原州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen, he traveled to Yuan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day, he traveled to Yuan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚午，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸津門，問百年，賜以錢帛，又賜高年板職各有差，降死罪一等。

translations.literal: On dingchou day he visited Jin Gate, inquired after centenarians, and bestowed money and silk; he also granted board appointments to the aged each according to rank, and reduced death sentences one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he visited Jin Gate, inquired after centenarians, and bestowed money and silk; he also granted board appointments to the aged according to rank and reduced death sentences one grade.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，改作露寢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei, the open-air sleeping hall was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on dingwei day, the open-air sleeping hall was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，自原州登隴山。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi, he ascended Long Mountain from Yuan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jiazi day, he ascended Long Mountain from Yuan Province.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Mars encroached upon the Grand Marshal in the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroached upon the Grand Marshal in the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸同州。

translations.literal: On bingxu day he visited Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day he visited Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔柱國楊忠率騎一萬與突厥伐齊。

translations.literal: On wuzi day an edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong to lead ten thousand horsemen with the Turks to attack Northern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong to lead ten thousand horsemen with the Turks against Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蒲州獻嘉禾，異畝同穎。

translations.literal: On jichou day Pu Province presented fine grain with different fields sharing the same ear.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Pu Province presented fine grain with different fields sharing the same ear.

sentences.zh: 初令世襲州郡縣者改為五等爵，州封伯，郡封子，縣封男。

translations.literal: It was first ordered that hereditary prefects of provinces, commanderies, and counties should be changed to five grades of nobility: provinces enfeoffed as earls, commanderies as viscounts, and counties as barons.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary prefects of provinces, commanderies, and counties were first changed to five grades of nobility: provinces as earls, commanderies as viscounts, and counties as barons.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renchen, Mars encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on renchen day, Mars encroached upon the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以開府、杞國公亮為梁州總管。

translations.literal: On yisi day Opening-the-Feudatory, Duke of Qi Liang, was made commander-in-chief of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Liang, Duke of Qi, opening-the-feudatory, was made commander-in-chief of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 十有二月辛卯，至自同州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao, he returned from Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on xinmao day, he returned from Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 遣太保、鄭國公達奚武率騎三萬出平陽以應楊忠。

translations.literal: The grand guardian, Duke of Zheng Daxi Wu, was dispatched to lead thirty thousand horsemen out of Pingyang to support Yang Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Daxi Wu, Duke of Zheng, was dispatched to lead thirty thousand horsemen out of Pingyang to support Yang Zhong.

sentences.zh: 是月，有人生子男，而陰在背後如尾，兩足指如獸爪。

translations.literal: That month, a man bore a male child whose genitals were on the back like a tail, and whose two toes were like beast claws.
translations.idiomatic: That month a man bore a male child whose genitals were on the back like a tail and whose two toes were like beast claws.

sentences.zh: 有犬生子，腰以後分為二身，兩尾六足。

translations.literal: A dog gave birth: from the waist backward the body divided into two, with two tails and six feet.
translations.idiomatic: A dog gave birth: from the waist backward the body divided into two, with two tails and six feet.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚申，楊忠破齊長城，至晉陽而還。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month of spring, day gengshen, Yang Zhong broke through Northern Qi's Great Wall, reached Jinyang, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month of spring, on gengshen day, Yang Zhong broke through Northern Qi's Great Wall, reached Jinyang, and returned.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Second month, first day gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the first day, gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲午，熒惑犯房右驂。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon the Right Outrigger of Room.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon the Right Outrigger of Room.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，熒惑又犯房右驂。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei, Mars again encroached upon the Right Outrigger of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on jiwei day, Mars again encroached upon the Right Outrigger of Room.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，初令百官執笏。

translations.literal: On gengchen day officials were first ordered to hold court tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day officials were first ordered to hold court tablets.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，以柱國、鄧公竇熾為大宗伯。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao, the pillar-of-state, Duke of Deng Dou Chi, was made grand clan elder.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, Pillar-of-State Dou Chi, Duke of Deng, was made grand clan elder.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，封世宗長子賢為畢國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu, Emperor Ming's eldest son Xian was enfeoffed as Duke of Bi state.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on renxu day, Emperor Ming's eldest son Xian was enfeoffed as duke of Bi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，突厥遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Turks sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Turkish envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以大將軍、安武公李穆為柱國。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the grand general, Duke of Anwu Li Mu, was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Grand General Li Mu, Duke of Anwu, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，改禮部為司宗，大司禮為禮部，大司樂為樂部。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Ministry of Rites was changed to Director of the Clan; the Grand Director of Rites to the Ministry of Rites; and the Grand Director of Music to the Ministry of Music.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Ministry of Rites was changed to Director of the Clan, the Grand Director of Rites to the Ministry of Rites, and the Grand Director of Music to the Ministry of Music.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，改御伯為納言。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin, the imperial censor was changed to speaking minister.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on gengyin day, the imperial censor was changed to speaking minister.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu,
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day,

translations.literal: (Li)
translations.idiomatic: (Li)

sentences.zh: 〔粟〕特遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: [Su]te sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，焉耆遣使獻名馬。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Yanqi sent envoys presenting famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Yanqi sent envoys presenting famous horses.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day dinghai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on the first day, dinghai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔柱國楊忠率師與突厥東伐，至北河而還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong to lead troops with the Turks in an eastern campaign, reached the Northern River, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong to lead troops with the Turks on an eastern campaign; he reached the Northern River and returned.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以柱國齊公憲為雍州牧，許國公宇文貴為大司徒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the pillar-of-state, Duke of Qi Xian, was made governor of Yong Province; Duke of Xu Yuwen Gui was made grand minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, was made governor of Yong Province; Yuwen Gui, Duke of Xu, was made grand minister of education.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，以柱國、衛國公直為大司空，封開府李昞為唐國公，若干鳳為徐國公。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi, the pillar-of-state, Duke of Wei Zhi, was made grand minister of works; Opening-the-Feudatory Li Bing was enfeoffed as Duke of Tang state, and Ruogan Feng as Duke of Xu state.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingsi day, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, was made grand minister of works; Li Bing, opening-the-feudatory, was enfeoffed as duke of Tang, and Ruogan Feng as duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 是月，以皇世母閻氏自齊至，大赦天下。

translations.literal: That month, because the imperial grandmother, Lady Yan, arrived from Northern Qi, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because the imperial grandmother Lady Yan arrived from Northern Qi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥，以大將軍韋孝寬、大將軍長孫儉並為柱國。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jihai, the grand general Wei Xiaokuan and the grand general Zhangsun Jian were both made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on jihai day, Grand Generals Wei Xiaokuan and Zhangsun Jian were both made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，以大將軍陸通、大將軍宇文盛、蔡國公廣並為柱國。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guihai, the grand general Lu Tong, the grand general Yuwen Sheng, and Duke of Cai Guang were all made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on guihai day, Grand Generals Lu Tong and Yuwen Sheng and Guang, Duke of Cai, were all made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔大將軍、大冢宰、晉國公護率軍伐齊，帝於太廟庭授以斧鉞。

translations.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered the grand general, grand chancellor, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu to lead troops against Northern Qi; the Emperor in the court of the Imperial Ancestors' Temple invested him with axe and halberd.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered Grand General and Grand Chancellor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu to lead troops against Northern Qi; the emperor invested him with axe and halberd in the court of the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 於是護總大軍出潼關，大將軍權景宣率山南諸軍出豫州，少師楊摽出

translations.literal: Thereupon Yuwen Hu commanded the great army out through Tong Pass; Grand General Quan Jingxuan led the armies south of the mountains out through Yu Province; Junior Preceptor Yang Biao out through
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yuwen Hu commanded the main army out through Tong Pass; Grand General Quan Jingxuan led the armies south of the mountains out through Yu Province; Junior Preceptor Yang Biao out through

translations.literal: (Zhi)
translations.idiomatic: (Zhi)

sentences.zh: 〔軹〕關。

translations.literal: [Zhi] Pass.
translations.idiomatic: [Zhi] Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸沙苑勞師。

translations.literal: On dingmao day he visited Shayuan to review the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he visited Shayuan to review the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，柱國、蜀國公尉遲迥率師圍洛陽，柱國、齊國公憲營於邙山，晉公護次於陝州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu, the pillar-of-state, Duke of Shu Yuchi Jiong, led troops to besiege Luoyang; the pillar-of-state, Duke of Qi Xian, encamped on Mount Mang; Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu halted at Shan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, led troops to besiege Luoyang; Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, encamped on Mount Mang; Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu halted at Shan Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月，權景宣攻齊豫州，刺史王士良以州降。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Quan Jingxuan attacked Northern Qi's Yu Province; the governor Wang Shiliang surrendered the province.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, Quan Jingxuan attacked Northern Qi's Yu Province; Governor Wang Shiliang surrendered the province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，齊師渡河，晨至洛陽，諸軍驚散。

translations.literal: On renxu day Northern Qi troops crossed the river; by morning they reached Luoyang, and the various armies scattered in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Northern Qi troops crossed the river; by morning they reached Luoyang and the various armies scattered in alarm.

sentences.zh: 尉遲迥率麾下數十騎扞敵，得卻，至夜引還。

translations.literal: Yuchi Jiong led several dozen horsemen of his personal following to resist the enemy, drove them back, and withdrew by night.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchi Jiong led several dozen horsemen of his personal following to resist the enemy, drove them back, and withdrew by night.

sentences.zh: 柱國、庸國公王雄力戰，死之。

translations.literal: The pillar-of-state, Duke of Yong Wang Xiong fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Wang Xiong, Duke of Yong, fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 遂班師。

translations.literal: Thereupon the armies withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the armies withdrew.

sentences.zh: 楊摽於軹關戰沒。

translations.literal: Yang Biao fell in battle at Zhi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Biao fell in battle at Zhi Pass.

sentences.zh: 權景宣亦棄豫州而還。

translations.literal: Quan Jingxuan also abandoned Yu Province and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Jingxuan also abandoned Yu Province and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲申朔，廢朝，以庸國公王雄死王事故也。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month of spring, first day jiashen, audience was suspended because Duke of Yong Wang Xiong had died in battle for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, first month of spring, on the first day, jiashen, court audience was suspended because Wang Xiong, Duke of Yong, had died in battle.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚子，令荊州、安州、江陵等總管並隸襄州總管府，以柱國、大司空、衛國公直為襄州總管。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the commanders-in-chief of Jing, An, Jiangling, and others were all placed under the Xiang Province command headquarters; the pillar-of-state, grand minister of works, Duke of Wei Zhi, was made commander-in-chief of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the commanders-in-chief of Jing, An, Jiangling, and others were all placed under the Xiang Province headquarters; Pillar-of-State Yuwen Zhi, grand minister of works and Duke of Wei, was made commander-in-chief of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太白、熒惑、歲星合於婁。

translations.literal: On yisi day Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吐谷渾遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以庸國公王雄世子開府謙為柱國。

translations.literal: Duke of Yong Wang Xiong's heir, Opening-the-Feudatory Qian, was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong's heir Qian, Duke of Yong and opening-the-feudatory, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，詔陳國公純、柱國許國公宇文貴、神武公竇毅、南安公楊

translations.literal: Second month, day xinyou, an edict ordered Duke of Chen Chun, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Gui, Duke of Xu, Divine Martial Duke Dou Yi, and Duke of Nan'an Yang
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on xinyou day, an edict ordered Duke of Chen Chun, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Gui, Duke of Xu, Divine Martial Duke Dou Yi, and Duke of Nan'an Yang

translations.literal: (Jian)
translations.idiomatic: (Jian)

sentences.zh: 〔薦〕等，如突厥逆女。

translations.literal: (Jian) [Jian] and others to go to the Turks to meet the bride.
translations.idiomatic: (Jian) [Jian] and others to go to the Turks to meet the bride.

sentences.zh: 甲子，郢州獲綠毛龜。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Ying Province captured a green-furred tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Ying Province captured a green-furred tortoise.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以柱國安武公李穆為大司空，綏德公陸通為大司寇。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the pillar-of-state, Duke of Anwu Li Mu, was made grand minister of works; Duke of Suide Lu Tong was made grand minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Pillar-of-State Li Mu, Duke of Anwu, was made grand minister of works; Lu Tong, Duke of Suide, was made grand minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 壬申，行幸岐州。

translations.literal: On renshen day he traveled to Qiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he traveled to Qiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，齊武成禪位於其太子緯，自稱太上皇帝。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, Northern Qi's Emperor Wucheng abdicated to his crown prince Wei and styled himself Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, Northern Qi's Emperor Wucheng abdicated to his crown prince Wei and styled himself Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，以皇族父興為大將軍，襲虞國公封。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingxu, the imperial clan father Xing was made grand general and inherited the enfeoffment of Duke of Yu state.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on bingxu day, the imperial clan father Xing was made grand general and inherited the enfeoffment as duke of Yu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔左右武伯各置中大夫一人。

translations.literal: On jihai day an edict ordered that each left and right martial guard should have one middle grandee appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict ordered that each left and right martial guard should appoint one middle grandee.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，彗星出三台，入文昌，犯上將，後經紫宮西垣入危，漸長一丈餘，指室、壁。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen, a comet appeared at the Three Terraces, entered Literary Glory, encroached upon the Grand Marshal, then passed the western wall of the Purple Palace and entered Danger, gradually lengthening to more than one zhang, pointing toward Encampment and Wall.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on gengshen day, a comet appeared at the Three Terraces, entered Literary Glory, encroached upon the Grand Marshal, then passed the western wall of the Purple Palace and entered Danger, gradually lengthening to more than one zhang and pointing toward Encampment and Wall.

sentences.zh: 後百餘日，稍短，長二尺五寸，在虛、危滅。

translations.literal: After more than a hundred days it gradually shortened to two chi five cun and vanished in Emptiness and Danger.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a hundred days it gradually shortened to two chi five cun and vanished in Emptiness and Danger.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔曰：「江陵人年六十五以上為官奴婢者，已令放免。

translations.literal: On xinwei day an edict said: "People of Jiangling aged sixty-five or older who had been made government bond-slaves have already been ordered released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict said: "People of Jiangling aged sixty-five or older who had been made government bond-slaves have already been ordered released.

sentences.zh: 其公私奴婢有年至七十以外者，所在官司，宜贖為庶人。」

translations.literal: As for private and public bond-slaves who have reached seventy or beyond, the local offices should redeem them as commoners."
translations.idiomatic: As for private and public bond-slaves aged seventy or beyond, local offices should redeem them as commoners."

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on the first day, xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，行幸秦州。

translations.literal: On day gengyin he traveled to Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Emperor Wu traveled to Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 降死罪以下。

translations.literal: Death sentences and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences and lesser punishments were commuted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣大使巡察天下。

translations.literal: On day xinchou he dispatched grand envoys to inspect the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he sent grand envoys to tour and inspect the realm.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，至自秦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day bingzi, he returned from Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on bingzi day, he returned from Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，益州獻三足烏。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day yisi, Yi Province presented a three-legged crow.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on yisi day, Yi Province presented a three-legged crow.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，改函谷關城為通洛防。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, day xinhai, Hangu Pass fortress was renamed Tongluo garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Hangu Pass was renamed the Tongluo garrison.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，岐州上言一角獸見。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day gengchen, Qi Province reported a one-horned beast seen.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on gengchen day, Qi Province reported a unicorn sighting.

sentences.zh: 甲午，吐谷渾遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day jiawu Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On day dingwei Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，以開府、中山公訓為蒲州總管。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen, the opening grandee, Duke of Zhongshan Xun was made inspector-general of Pu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on wushen day, Opening Grandee Yuwen Xun, Duke of Zhongshan, was made inspector-general of Pu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔三公已下各舉所知。

translations.literal: On day wuchen an edict said: "From the Three Excellencies down, each shall recommend those he knows."
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered the Three Excellencies and all below to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 庚午，日鬥，光遂微，日裏烏見。

translations.literal: On day gengwu the sun battled; its light then grew faint, and a crow was seen within the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the sun darkened, its light waned, and a crow appeared within the disk.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，祠南郊。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on bingwu day, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，帝御正武殿，集羣臣親講《禮記》。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day gengchen, the Emperor presided at the Hall of Righteous Martialness, gathered the ministers, and personally lectured on the Record of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on gengchen day, Emperor Wu presided at the Hall of Righteous Martialness, assembled his ministers, and personally expounded the Record of Rites.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾龍涸王莫昌率戶內附，以其地為扶州。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun's King of Longge Mo Chang led his households to submit; his territory was made Fu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Chang, Tuyuhun king of Longge, led his people to submit; his lands were organized as Fu Province.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔曰：「道德交喪，禮義嗣興。

translations.literal: On day jiawu an edict said: "When virtue and the Way are both lost, ritual and righteousness rise in their turn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict declared: "When virtue and the Way are both lost, ritual and righteousness rise in their turn.

sentences.zh: 褒四始於一言，美三千於為敬。

translations.literal: Praise begins in a single word; three thousand rules find their beauty in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Praise begins in a single word; three thousand rules find their beauty in reverence.

sentences.zh: 是以在上不驕，處滿不溢，富貴所以長守，邦國於焉乂安。

translations.literal: Thus the superior is not arrogant, the full does not overflow—wealth and rank are thereby long kept, and the state settled in order.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the superior is not arrogant and the full does not overflow—wealth and rank are long kept, and the state stands in order.

sentences.zh: 故能承天靜地，和民敬鬼，明並日月，道錯四時。

translations.literal: So one can receive Heaven and quiet Earth, harmonize the people and revere the spirits, brightness matching sun and moon, the Way aligning the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: So one receives Heaven and quiets Earth, harmonizes the people and reveres the spirits, matches sun and moon in brightness, and aligns the Way with the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 朕雖庸昧，有志前古。

translations.literal: Though I am dull and obscure, I aspire to the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: Though I am dull and obscure, I aspire to the ancients.

sentences.zh: 甲子乙卯，禮雲不樂。

translations.literal: On jiazi and yimao days ritual says: no music.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi and yimao days ritual says there should be no music.

sentences.zh: 萇弘表昆吾之稔，杜蕢有揚觶之文。

translations.literal: Chang Hong displayed Kunwu's ripeness; Du Kui had the text of raising the wine cup.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Hong displayed Kunwu's ripeness; Du Kui had the text of raising the wine cup.

sentences.zh: 自世道喪亂，禮儀紊毀，此典茫然，已墜於地。

translations.literal: Since the age fell to disorder, ritual and ceremony were tangled and ruined; this standard lies in confusion, already fallen to earth.
translations.idiomatic: Since the age fell to disorder, ritual and ceremony were tangled and ruined; this standard lies in confusion, already fallen to earth.

sentences.zh: 昔周王受命，請聞顓頊。

translations.literal: Formerly when the Zhou king received the mandate, he asked to hear from Zhuanxu.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when the Zhou king received the mandate, he asked to hear from Zhuanxu.

sentences.zh: 廟有戒盈之器，室為復禮之銘。

translations.literal: In the temple was the vessel warning against fullness; in the chamber was the inscription on restoring ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the temple was the vessel warning against fullness; in the chamber was the inscription on restoring ritual.

sentences.zh: 矧伊末學，而能忘此。

translations.literal: How much less should one of slight learning forget this!
translations.idiomatic: How much less should one of slight learning forget this!

sentences.zh: 宜依是日，省事停樂。

translations.literal: On these days affairs should be simplified and music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On these days affairs should be simplified and music stopped.

sentences.zh: 庶知為君之難，為臣不易。

translations.literal: Perhaps all may know the difficulty of being ruler and the hardship of being minister.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps all may know the difficulty of being ruler and the hardship of being minister.

sentences.zh: 貽之後昆，殷鑒斯在。」

translations.literal: Leave this to later generations; a stern mirror stands here."
translations.idiomatic: Leave this to later generations; a stern mirror stands here."

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，以大將軍、枹罕公辛威為柱國。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu, Grand General, Duke of Baohan Xin Wei was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on bingwu day, Grand General Xin Wei, Duke of Baohan, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，築武功、郿、斜谷、武都、留穀、津坑諸城，以置軍人。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day wuyin, fortresses at Wugong, Mei, Xiegu, Wudu, Liugu, and Jinkeng were built to station troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on wuyin day, he built fortresses at Wugong, Mei, Xiegu, Wudu, Liugu, and Jinkeng to station troops.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔：「諸冑子入學，但束修於師，不勞釋奠。

translations.literal: On day renwu an edict said: "Imperial students entering school need only present the teacher's gift; they need not perform the libation sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict said: "Imperial students entering school need only present the teacher's gift; they need not perform the libation sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 釋奠者，學成之祭，自今卽為恆式。」

translations.literal: The libation sacrifice is the rite of completed study; from now on let this be the fixed rule."
translations.idiomatic: The libation sacrifice marks completed study; from now on let this be the fixed rule."

sentences.zh: 八月己未，詔：「諸有三年之喪，或負土成墳，或寢苫骨立，一志一行，可稱揚者，仰本部官司，隨事言上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiwei, an edict said: "All who observe the three-year mourning, or carry earth to make a mound, or sleep on straw until bone shows—one will, one conduct worthy of praise—let the relevant offices of their home districts report each case upward.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiwei day, an edict said: "All who observe three-year mourning, heap earth into a grave mound, or sleep on straw until bone shows—single-minded in one deed worthy of praise—let local offices report each case upward.

sentences.zh: 當加吊勉，以厲薄俗。」

translations.literal: They should receive condolence and encouragement to stiffen lax custom."
translations.idiomatic: They should receive condolence and encouragement to stiffen lax custom."

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，信州蠻冉令賢、向五子王反，詔開府陸騰討平之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day yihai, Xin Province barbarians Ran Lingxian and Xiang Wuzi Wang rebelled; an edict ordered Opening Grandee Lu Teng to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on yihai day, Xin Province barbarians Ran Lingxian and Xiang Wuzi Wang rebelled; the court ordered Opening Grandee Lu Teng to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yimao, Venus was seen by day and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on yimao day, Venus appeared by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 甲子，初造《山雲舞》，以備六代之樂。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the Mountain Cloud Dance was first created to complete the music of the six dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Mountain Cloud Dance was first created to complete the music of the six dynasties.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，行幸武功等新城。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu, he traveled to the new cities at Wugong and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on bingxu day, he traveled to the new cities at Wugong and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengshen day, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day guiyou on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month of spring, on the guiyou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On day jihai he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he performed the ceremonial plowing at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，改武遊園為道會苑。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiyou, the Martial Excursion Garden was renamed the Dao Assembly Park.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on guiyou day, the Martial Excursion Garden was renamed the Dao Assembly Park.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，初立郊丘壇壝制度。

translations.literal: On day dinghai the regulations for suburban mound and enclosure were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the regulations for the suburban mound and its enclosure were first established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，省東南諸州：以穎州、歸州、溳州、均州入唐州，油州入純州，鴻州入淮州，洞州入湖州，睢州入襄州，憲州入昌州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi, southeastern provinces were reduced: Ying, Gui, Yu, and Jun provinces entered Tang Province; You entered Chun Province; Hong entered Huai Province; Dong entered Hu Province; Sui entered Xiang Province; and Xian entered Chang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on yisi day, southeastern provinces were consolidated: Ying, Gui, Yu, and Jun were merged into Tang Province; You into Chun; Hong into Huai; Dong into Hu; Sui into Xiang; and Xian into Chang.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、陳國公純為柱國。

translations.literal: Grand General, Duke of Chen State Chun was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Yuwen Chun, Duke of Chen, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，突厥、吐谷渾、安息並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen, the Turks, Tuyuhun, and Parthia all sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on renshen day, the Turks, Tuyuhun, and Parthia all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，進封柱國、安武公李穆為申國公。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Pillar-of-State, Duke of Anwu Li Mu was advanced to Duke of Shen State.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Pillar-of-State Li Mu, Duke of Anwu, was promoted to Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，歲星與熒惑合於井。

translations.literal: On day jichou Jupiter and Mars conjoined in the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Jupiter and Mars conjoined in the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，尊所生叱奴氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai, his birth mother Lady Chinu was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinhai day, his birth mother Lady Chinu was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲子，月入畢。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the moon entered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon entered the Bi asterism.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，地震。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengwu, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，陳湘州刺史華皎率衆來附，遣襄州總管衛國公直率柱國綏

translations.literal: On day wuyin Chen's governor of Xiang Province Hua Jiao led the masses to submit; he dispatched Xiang Province inspector-general Duke of Wei State Zhi leading pillar-of-state Suide
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Chen's governor of Xiang Province, Hua Jiao, surrendered with his forces; the court sent Xiang Province inspector-general Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, with Pillar-of-State

translations.literal: (State)
translations.idiomatic: Suide

sentences.zh: 〔德〕公陸通、大將軍田弘、權景宣、元定等，將兵援之，因而南伐。

translations.literal: Duke Lu Tong, Grand General Tian Hong, Quan Jingxuan, Yuan Ding, and others led troops to support him, and then marched south to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tong, Duke of Suide, Grand General Tian Hong, Quan Jingxuan, Yuan Ding, and others with troops to support him, then marched south in campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以大將軍、譙國公儉為柱國。

translations.literal: On day renchen Grand General, Duke of Qiao State Jian was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Grand General Yuwen Jian, Duke of Qiao, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，歲星、太白合於柳。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Jupiter and Venus conjoined in Willow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Jupiter and Venus conjoined in the Willow asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，襄州上言慶雲見。

translations.literal: On day wuxu Xiang Province reported auspicious clouds seen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xiang Province reported auspicious clouds.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，梁州上言鳳凰集於楓樹，羣鳥列侍以萬數。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinchou, Liang Province reported a phoenix gathered on a maple tree, with birds arrayed in attendance by the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on xinchou day, Liang Province reported a phoenix on a maple tree with tens of thousands of birds arrayed in attendance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立露門學，置生七十二人。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the Lumen Academy was established, with seventy-two students enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Lumen Academy was established with seventy-two students.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On day gengxu Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Venus encroached upon the Xuanyuan asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬子，乙太傅、燕國公於謹為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On day renzi Grand Tutor, Duke of Yan State Yu Jin was posted as governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Grand Tutor Yu Jin, Duke of Yan, was posted as governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 九月，衛國公直等與陳將淳于量、吳明徹戰於沌口，王師失利。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Duke of Wei State Zhi and others fought Chen generals Chunyu Liang and Wu Mingche at Dun mouth; the royal army suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, and others fought Chen generals Chunyu Liang and Wu Mingche at Dun mouth; the Zhou army was defeated.

sentences.zh: 元定以步騎數千先度，遂沒江南。

translations.literal: Yuan Ding with several thousand infantry and cavalry crossed first and was lost south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ding crossed first with several thousand foot and horse and was lost south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，日出入時，有黑氣一，大如杯，在日中。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day xinmao, at sunrise there was one black vapor, as large as a cup, within the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, at sunrise a black spot the size of a cup appeared in the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲午，又加一焉。

translations.literal: On day jiawu there was one more.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day a second appeared.

sentences.zh: 經六日乃滅。

translations.literal: After six days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: After six days they vanished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the wuxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太保、許國公宇文貴薨。

translations.literal: On day guichou Grand Commander, Duke of Xu State Yuwen Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Grand Commander Yuwen Gui, Duke of Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛丑，祠南郊。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day xinchou, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month of spring, on xinchou day, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，幸武功。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao, he visited Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on dingmao day, he visited Wugong.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On day dinghai he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，乙太保、鄭國公達奚武為太傅，大司馬、蜀國公尉遲迥為太保，柱國、齊國公憲為大司馬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi, Grand Commander, Duke of Zheng State Daxi Wu was posted as grand tutor; Grand Marshal, Duke of Shu State Yuchi Jiong as grand commander; Pillar-of-State, Duke of Qi State Xian as grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on xinsi day, Grand Commander Daxi Wu, Duke of Zheng, was posted as grand tutor; Grand Marshal Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, as grand commander; and Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 太白入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: Venus entered the Ghost asterism and encroached upon the Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the Ghost asterism and encroached upon the Accumulated Corpses.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，祠太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on gengxu day, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，行幸醴泉宮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen he traveled to Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he traveled to Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，有星孛於東井，北行一月，至輿鬼，乃滅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu, a broom star appeared in the Eastern Well; going north for one month, it reached the Ghost asterism and then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiaxu day, a broom star appeared in the Eastern Well; traveling north for a month it reached the Ghost asterism and vanished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，柱國、隨國公楊忠薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day renyin, Pillar-of-State, Duke of Sui State Yang Zhong died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong, Duke of Sui, died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，至自醴泉宮。

translations.literal: On day wuwu he returned from Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day he returned from Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，客星見房，漸東行入天市，犯營室，至奎，四十餘日乃滅。

translations.literal: On day jiwei a guest star appeared in Fang; gradually going east it entered the Celestial Market, encroached upon Encampment Chamber, reached Kui, and after more than forty days vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day a guest star appeared in Fang; moving east it entered the Celestial Market, encroached upon Encampment Chamber, reached Kui, and vanished after more than forty days.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，太白與鎮星合於角。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengxu, Venus and Saturn conjoined in Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengxu day, Venus and Saturn conjoined in the Horn asterism.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，祠太廟。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day guihai, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on guihai day, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白入氐。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Venus entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus entered the Di asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上親率六軍講武於城南，京邑觀者，輿馬彌漫數十里，諸蕃使咸在焉。

translations.literal: On day dinghai the sovereign personally led the six armies in martial exercises south of the city; spectators in the capital filled carriage and horse for several tens of li, and envoys of the various tribes were all present.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor personally led the six armies in martial exercises south of the city; spectators in the capital filled the roads for tens of li, and envoys of the various tribes were all present.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the renchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸岐陽。

translations.literal: On day jiachen he traveled to Qiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he traveled to Qiyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣開府崔彥穆、小賓部元暉使於齊。

translations.literal: On day renzi he dispatched Opening Grandee Cui Yanmu and Junior Guest Minister Yuan Hui as envoys to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day he sent Opening Grandee Cui Yanmu and Junior Guest Minister Yuan Hui as envoys to Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，陳安成王頊廢其主伯宗而自立，是為宣帝。

translations.literal: On day jiayin Chen's Prince of Ancheng Xu deposed his ruler Bozong and established himself; this was Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Chen's Prince of Ancheng, Xu, deposed his ruler Bozong and took the throne as Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，以柱國、昌甯公長孫儉為夏州總管。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai, Pillar-of-State, Duke of Changning Changsun Jian was made inspector-general of Xia Province.
