translations.idiomatic: Second month, on guihai day, Pillar-of-State Changsun Jian, Duke of Changning, was made inspector-general of Xia Province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝御大德殿，集百僚、道士、沙門等討論釋老義。

translations.literal: On day wuchen the Emperor presided at the Hall of Great Virtue, gathered the hundred officials, Daoist priests, and Buddhist monks, and debated the meaning of Buddhism and Daoism.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Emperor Wu presided at the Hall of Great Virtue, assembled officials, Daoist priests, and Buddhist monks, and debated the teachings of Buddhism and Daoism.

sentences.zh: 歲星逆行，掩太微上將。

translations.literal: Jupiter went retrograde and covered the Supreme General of the Grand Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter went retrograde and covered the Supreme General of the Grand Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有流星大如鬥，出左攝提，流至天津，滅後，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On day gengwu a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Left Sheti, streamed to Tianjin, and after vanishing there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Left Sheti, streamed to Tianjin, and after vanishing a sound like thunder followed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer

translations.literal: (yi)
translations.idiomatic: yi

sentences.zh: 〔己〕巳，齊遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，帝制《象經》成，集百僚講說。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jichou, the Emperor's composition the Classic of Images was completed; he gathered the hundred officials to lecture on it.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jichou day, Emperor Wu's Classic of Images was completed; he assembled officials to lecture on it.

sentences.zh: 封魏廣平公子元謙為韓國公，以紹魏後。

translations.literal: Yuan Qian, son of Wei's Prince of Guangping, was enfeoffed as Duke of Han State to continue the Wei line.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qian, son of Wei's Prince of Guangping, was enfeoffed as Duke of Han to continue the Wei line.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，行幸醴泉宮。

translations.literal: On day gengxu he traveled to Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he traveled to Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，柱國、吳國公尉遲綱薨。

translations.literal: On day dingsi Pillar-of-State, Duke of Wu State Yuchi Gang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Pillar-of-State Yuchi Gang, Duke of Wu, died.

sentences.zh: 六月，築原州及涇州東城。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Yuan Province and the eastern wall of Jing Province were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yuan Province and the eastern wall of Jing Province were built.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，至自醴泉宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinhai, he returned from Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, he returned from Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，突厥遣使獻馬。

translations.literal: On day dingsi the Turks sent envoys presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Turks sent envoys with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，盜殺孔城防主，以其地入齊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day gengchen, bandits killed the Kongcheng garrison commander; that territory passed to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengchen day, bandits killed the Kongcheng garrison commander and the territory passed to Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，遣柱國、齊國公憲率衆於宜陽築崇德等城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day xinmao, he dispatched Pillar-of-State, Duke of Qi State Xian to lead the masses in building Chongde and other cities at Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on xinmao day, he sent Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, with troops to build Chongde and other cities at Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛亥，柱國、昌甯公長孫儉薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day xinhai, Pillar-of-State, Duke of Changning Changsun Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month of winter, on xinhai day, Pillar-of-State Changsun Jian, Duke of Changning, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，罷隴州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu, Long Province was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renwu day, Long Province was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月己巳，邵惠公顥孫冑自齊來歸。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, second month, day jisi, Duke Hui of Shao Hao's grandson Zhou returned from Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, second month of spring, on jisi day, Yuwen Zhou, grandson of Duke Hui of Shao Yuwen Hao, returned from Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 改邵國公會為譚國公，封冑為邵國公。

translations.literal: Duke of Shao State Hui was changed to Duke of Tan State; Zhou was enfeoffed as Duke of Shao State.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hui, Duke of Shao, was retitled Duke of Tan; Yuwen Zhou was enfeoffed as Duke of Shao.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，進封柱國韋孝寬為鄖國公。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao, Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan was advanced to Duke of Yun State.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on xinmao day, Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan was promoted to Duke of Yun.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，初令宿衛官住關外者，將家累入京，不樂者，解宿衛。

translations.literal: On day jiachen it was first ordered that palace-guard officials stationed outside the passes should bring their families into the capital; those unwilling might leave palace-guard service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day it was first ordered that palace-guard officers posted outside the passes should move their families into the capital; those unwilling could leave guard service.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以柱國宇文盛為大宗伯。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng was made grand director of ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng was made grand director of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 行幸醴泉宮。

translations.literal: He traveled to Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled to Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 省帥都督官。

translations.literal: The office of commander-in-chief was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The office of commander-in-chief was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣大使巡天下。

translations.literal: On day bingyin he dispatched grand envoys to tour the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he sent grand envoys to tour the realm.

sentences.zh: 以陳國公純為陝州總管。

translations.literal: Duke of Chen State Chun was made inspector-general of Shan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Chun, Duke of Chen, was made inspector-general of Shan Province.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，封開府梁睿為蔣國公。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen, Opening Grandee Liang Rui was enfeoffed as Duke of Jiang State.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on renchen day, Opening Grandee Liang Rui was enfeoffed as Duke of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，降宥罪人，並免逋租懸調等，以皇女生故也。

translations.literal: On day gengzi criminals were pardoned and reduced, and overdue rents and suspended levies were all remitted, because of the birth of an imperial daughter.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day criminals were pardoned and reduced, and overdue rents and suspended levies were all remitted, because an imperial daughter had been born.

sentences.zh: 七月，鹽州獻白兔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yan Province presented a white hare.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yan Province presented a white hare.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，至自醴泉宮。

translations.literal: On day yimao he returned from Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he returned from Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以柱國、譙國公儉為益州總管。

translations.literal: On day xinsi Pillar-of-State, Duke of Qiao State Jian was made inspector-general of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Jian, Duke of Qiao, was made inspector-general of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，太白、歲星合於亢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day jimao, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jimao day, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Kang asterism.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day xinsi on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on the xinsi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白、鎮星合於氐。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Venus and Saturn conjoined in Di.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus and Saturn conjoined in the Di asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太傅、鄭國公達奚武薨。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Grand Tutor, Duke of Zheng State Daxi Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Grand Tutor Daxi Wu, Duke of Zheng, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，大將軍鄭恪率師平越巂，置西寧州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi, Grand General Zheng Ke led troops to pacify Yuexi and established Xi'ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guisi day, Grand General Zheng Ke led troops to pacify Yuexi and established Xi'ning Province.

sentences.zh: 是冬，齊將斛律明月寇邊，於汾北築城，自華谷至於龍門。

translations.literal: That winter Northern Qi's general Hulu Mingyue raided the border, building a fortress north of the Fen from Huagu to Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Northern Qi general Hulu Mingyue raided the frontier and built a fortress north of the Fen from Huagu to Longmen.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己酉朔，廢朝，以露門未成故也。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day jiyou on the new moon, court was suspended because the Lumen Gate was not yet completed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, first month of spring, on the jiyou new moon, court was suspended because the Lumen Gate was not yet finished.

sentences.zh: 詔柱國、齊國公憲率師禦斛律明月。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Pillar-of-State, Duke of Qi State Xian to lead troops against Hulu Mingyue.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, to lead troops against Hulu Mingyue.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以大將軍張掖公王傑、譚國公會、鴈門公田弘、魏國公李暉等並為柱國。

translations.literal: On day dingmao Grand General, Duke of Zhangye Wang Jie, Duke of Tan State Hui, Duke of Yanmen Tian Hong, Duke of Wei State Li Hui, and others were all made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Grand General Wang Jie, Duke of Zhangye; Yuwen Hui, Duke of Tan; Tian Hong, Duke of Yanmen; Li Hui, Duke of Wei; and others were all made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑夜，有蒼雲廣三尺許經天，自戌加辰。

translations.literal: Second month, night of day jichou, blue clouds about three chi wide crossed the sky from xu through chen.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the night of jichou day, blue clouds about three feet wide crossed the sky from xu through chen.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，齊國公憲自龍門度河，斛律明月退保華穀，憲攻拔其新築五城。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou, Duke of Qi State Xian crossed the river at Longmen; Hulu Mingyue withdrew to hold Huagu; Xian attacked and captured his five newly built cities.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on jiyou day, Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, crossed the river at Longmen; Hulu Mingyue withdrew to Huagu; Xian attacked and captured his five newly built cities.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on the wuyin new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On day jimao Mars encroached upon the Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Mars encroached upon the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，信州蠻渠冉祖喜、冉龍驤舉兵反，遣大將軍趙誾率師討平之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao Xin Province barbarian chieftains Ran Zuxi and Ran Longxiang raised troops in rebellion; he dispatched Grand General Zhao Yan to lead troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Xin Province barbarian chieftains Ran Zuxi and Ran Longxiang rebelled; he sent Grand General Zhao Yan with troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以柱國、燕國公于寔為涼州總管，大將軍、杞國公亮為秦州總管。

translations.literal: On day jiawu Pillar-of-State, Duke of Yan State Yu Shi was made inspector-general of Liang Province; Grand General, Duke of Qi State Liang was made inspector-general of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Pillar-of-State Yu Shi, Duke of Yan, was made inspector-general of Liang Province; Grand General Yuwen Liang, Duke of Qi, was made inspector-general of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以大將軍、滎陽公司馬消難為柱國。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Grand General, Duke of Xingyang Sima Xiaonan was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Grand General Sima Xiaonan, Duke of Xingyang, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 陳國公純、鴈門公田弘率師取齊宜陽等九城。

translations.literal: Duke of Chen State Chun and Duke of Yanmen Tian Hong led troops to take nine Qi cities including Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Chun, Duke of Chen, and Tian Hong, Duke of Yanmen, led troops to take nine Northern Qi cities including Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍武安公侯莫陳瓊、太安公閻慶、神武公竇毅、南陽公叱羅協、平高公侯伏侯龍恩並為柱國。

translations.literal: Grand General, Duke of Wu'an Houmochen Qiong; Duke of Tai'an Yan Qing; Duke of Shenwu Dou Yi; Duke of Nanyang Chiluo Xie; and Duke of Pinggao Houfu Hou Longen were all made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Houmochen Qiong, Duke of Wu'an; Yan Qing, Duke of Tai'an; Dou Yi, Duke of Shenwu; Chiluo Xie, Duke of Nanyang; and Houfu Hou Longen, Duke of Pinggao, were all made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 封開府斛斯徵為岐國公，右宮伯長孫覽為薛國公。

translations.literal: Opening Grandee Husi Zheng was enfeoffed as Duke of Qi State; Right Palace Baron Changsun Lan as Duke of Xue State.
translations.idiomatic: Opening Grandee Husi Zheng was enfeoffed as Duke of Qi; Right Palace Baron Changsun Lan as Duke of Xue.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，遣納言鄭詡使於陳。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao, he dispatched Remonstrance Counselor Zheng Xu as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on guimao day, he sent Remonstrance Counselor Zheng Xu as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以大將軍唐國公李昞、中山公訓、杞國公亮、上庸公陸騰、安義公宇文丘、北平公寇紹、許國公宇文善、犍為公高琳、鄭國公達奚震、隴東公楊纂、常山公于翼並為柱國。

translations.literal: On day bingyin Grand General, Duke of Tang State Li Bing; Duke of Zhongshan Xun; Duke of Qi State Liang; Duke of Shangyong Lu Teng; Duke of Anyi Yuwen Qiu; Duke of Beiping Kou Shao; Duke of Xu State Yuwen Shan; Duke of Jianwei Gao Lin; Duke of Zheng State Daxi Zhen; Duke of Longdong Yang Zuan; and Duke of Changshan Yu Yi were all made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Grand General Li Bing, Duke of Tang; Yuwen Xun, Duke of Zhongshan; Yuwen Liang, Duke of Qi; Lu Teng, Duke of Shangyong; Yuwen Qiu, Duke of Anyi; Kou Shao, Duke of Beiping; Yuwen Shan, Duke of Xu; Gao Lin, Duke of Jianwei; Daxi Zhen, Duke of Zheng; Yang Zuan, Duke of Longdong; and Yu Yi, Duke of Changshan, were all made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，以大將軍、太原公王柬為柱國。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei, Grand General, Duke of Taiyuan Wang Jian was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yiwei day, Grand General Wang Jian, Duke of Taiyuan, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊將段孝先攻陷汾州。

translations.literal: That month Northern Qi's general Duan Xiaoxian attacked and captured Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: That month Northern Qi general Duan Xiaoxian attacked and captured Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，以大將軍、越國公盛為柱國。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yichou, Grand General, Duke of Yue State Sheng was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on yichou day, Grand General Yuwen Sheng, Duke of Yue, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，鎮星、歲星、太白合於氐。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day guiwei, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus conjoined in Di.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on guiwei day, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus conjoined in the Di asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，月在婁，蝕之旣，光不復。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengshen, the moon was in Lou and eclipsed; after the eclipse its light did not return.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengshen day, the moon was in Lou and eclipsed; after the eclipse its light did not return.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，省掖庭四夷樂、後宮羅綺工人五百餘人。

translations.literal: On day guiyou more than five hundred performers of foreign music in the Palace Women's Quarters and silk workers in the rear palace were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day more than five hundred performers of foreign music in the Palace Women's Quarters and silk workers in the rear palace were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，以大將軍梁國公侯莫陳芮、大將軍李意並為柱國。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi, Grand General, Duke of Liang State Houmochen Rui and Grand General Li Yi were both made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renzi day, Grand General Houmochen Rui, Duke of Liang, and Grand General Li Yi were both made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，齊遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，行幸散關。

translations.literal: On day dingsi he traveled to San Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he traveled to San Pass.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，還宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jichou day, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是冬，牛大疫，死者十六七。

translations.literal: That winter cattle suffered a great epidemic; six or seven in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: That winter cattle suffered a great epidemic; six or seven in ten died.

sentences.zh: 建德元年春正月戊午，帝幸玄都觀，親御法座講說，公卿道俗論難，事畢還宮。

translations.literal: Jiande first year, spring, first month, day wuwu, the Emperor visited Xuandu Abbey, personally presided at the dharma seat to lecture, and when the dukes, ministers, clergy, and laity had debated, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: First year of Jiande, first month of spring, on wuwu day, Emperor Wu visited Xuandu Abbey, personally lectured from the dharma seat, and after dukes, ministers, clergy, and laity had debated, returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 降死罪及流罪一等，其五歲刑已下，並宥之。

translations.literal: Death sentences and exile were reduced one grade; punishments of five years or less were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences and exile were commuted one grade; punishments of five years or less were all forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on the guimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 齊遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，誅大冢宰晉國公護、護子柱國譚國公會、會弟大將軍莒國公至、崇業公靜，並柱國侯伏侯龍恩、龍恩弟大將軍萬壽、大將軍劉勇等。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Chief Minister Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, his son Pillar-of-State Duke of Tan State Hui, Hui's younger brother Grand General Duke of Ju State Zhi, Duke of Chongye Jing, and Pillar-of-State Houfu Hou Longen, Longen's younger brother Grand General Wanshou, Grand General Liu Yong, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Chief Minister Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, his son Pillar-of-State Yuwen Hui, Duke of Tan, Hui's younger brother Grand General Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Ju, Yuwen Jing, Duke of Chongye, Pillar-of-State Houfu Hou Longen, Longen's younger brother Grand General Wanshou, Grand General Liu Yong, and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 罷中外府。

translations.literal: The central and external headquarters were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The central and external headquarters were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，乙太傅、蜀國公尉遲迥為太師，柱國鄧國公竇熾為太傅，大司空、申國公李穆為太保，齊國公憲為大冢宰，衛國公直為大司徒，趙國公招為大司空，柱國枹罕公辛威為大司寇，綏德公陸通為大司馬。

translations.literal: On day guihai Grand Tutor, Duke of Shu State Yuchi Jiong was posted as grand preceptor; Pillar-of-State, Duke of Deng State Dou Chi as grand tutor; Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Shen State Li Mu as grand commander; Duke of Qi State Xian as chief minister; Duke of Wei State Zhi as grand minister of education; Duke of Zhao State Zhao as grand minister of works; Pillar-of-State, Duke of Baohan Xin Wei as grand minister of justice; and Duke of Suide Lu Tong as grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Grand Tutor Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, was posted as grand preceptor; Pillar-of-State Dou Chi, Duke of Deng, as grand tutor; Grand Minister of Works Li Mu, Duke of Shen, as grand commander; Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, as chief minister; Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, as grand minister of education; Yuwen Zhao, Duke of Zhao, as grand minister of works; Pillar-of-State Xin Wei, Duke of Baohan, as grand minister of justice; and Lu Tong, Duke of Suide, as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「民亦勞止，則星動於天；

translations.literal: An edict said: "When the people are weary to the limit, stars move in Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "When the people are weary to the limit, stars move in Heaven;

sentences.zh: 作事不時，則石言於國。

translations.literal: when work is untimely, stones speak in the state.
translations.idiomatic: when work is untimely, stones speak in the state.

sentences.zh: 故知為政欲靜，靜在寧民；

translations.literal: Thus one knows that in governing one desires quiet, and quiet rests in settling the people;
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows that in governing one desires quiet, and quiet rests in settling the people;

sentences.zh: 為治欲安，安在息役。

translations.literal: in ordering rule one desires peace, and peace rests in ceasing corvée.
translations.idiomatic: in ordering rule one desires peace, and peace rests in ceasing corvée.

sentences.zh: 頃興造無度，徵發不已，加以頻歲師旅，農畝廢業。

translations.literal: Lately construction has been without measure and levies without end; added to this, year after year of campaigns have left fields abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Lately construction has been without measure and levies without end; added to this, year after year of campaigns have left fields abandoned.

sentences.zh: 去秋災蝗，年穀不登，民有散亡，家空杼軸。

translations.literal: Last autumn locusts brought disaster; the year's grain did not ripen; people scattered in flight; homes were empty of looms.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn locusts brought disaster; the year's grain did not ripen; people scattered in flight; homes were empty of looms.

sentences.zh: 朕每旦恭己，夕惕兢懷。

translations.literal: Each morning I respectfully examine myself; each evening I tremble in caution.
translations.idiomatic: Each morning I respectfully examine myself; each evening I tremble in caution.

sentences.zh: 自今正調以外，無妄徵發。

translations.literal: From now on, apart from regular levies, there shall be no reckless conscription.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, apart from regular levies, there shall be no reckless conscription.

sentences.zh: 庶時殷俗阜，稱朕意焉。」

translations.literal: May the age grow rich and custom flourish—this is my wish."
translations.idiomatic: May the age grow rich and custom flourish—this is my wish."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以代國公達、滕國公逌並為柱國。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu, Duke of Dai State Da and Duke of Teng State You were both made pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on jiaxu day, Yuwen Da, Duke of Dai, and Yuwen You, Duke of Teng, were both made pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 詔荊州、安州、江陵等總管停隸襄州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the inspector-generals of Jing, An, and Jiangling provinces to cease subordination to Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the inspector-generals of Jing, An, and Jiangling provinces to cease reporting to Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以柱國張掖公王傑為涇州總管，魏國公李暉為梁州總管。

translations.literal: On day jimao Pillar-of-State, Duke of Zhangye Wang Jie was made inspector-general of Jing Province; Duke of Wei State Li Hui was made inspector-general of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Pillar-of-State Wang Jie, Duke of Zhangye, was made inspector-general of Jing Province; Li Hui, Duke of Wei, was made inspector-general of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 詔公卿以下各舉所知。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the dukes, ministers, and all below to recommend those they knew.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered dukes, ministers, and all below to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 遣工部代公達、小禮部辛彥之使於齊。

translations.literal: He dispatched Minister of Works Yuwen Da and Junior Minister of Rites Xin Yanzhi as envoys to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Minister of Works Yuwen Da and Junior Minister of Rites Xin Yanzhi as envoys to Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔百官軍民上封事，極言得失。

translations.literal: On day bingxu an edict ordered officials, soldiers, and commoners to submit sealed memorials speaking frankly of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered officials, soldiers, and commoners to submit sealed memorials speaking frankly of gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔斷四方非常貢獻。

translations.literal: On day dinghai an edict cut off extraordinary tribute from the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict cut off extraordinary tribute from the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，追尊略陽公為孝閔皇帝。

translations.literal: On day gengyin Duke of Lueyang was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaomin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Duke of Lueyang was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaomin.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立魯國公贇為皇太子。

translations.literal: On day guisi Duke of Lu State Yun was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yuwen Yun, Duke of Lu, was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，百官各加封級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire; officials all received advanced enfeoffment ranks.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; officials all received advanced enfeoffment ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月，封衛國公直長子賓為莒國公，紹莒莊公洛生後。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Duke of Wei State Zhi's eldest son Bin was enfeoffed as Duke of Ju State to continue the line of Duke Zhuang of Ju Luosheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yuwen Zhi's eldest son Bin, Duke of Wei, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ju to continue the line of Duke Zhuang of Ju Luosheng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，帝以大旱，集百官於庭，詔之曰：「盛農之節，亢陽不雨，氣序愆度，蓋不徒然。

translations.literal: On day renxu, because of great drought the Emperor gathered the hundred officials in the courtyard and addressed them: "In the height of farming season, blazing sun without rain—the seasonal order is wrong; this is not without cause.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, because of great drought the emperor gathered officials in the courtyard and addressed them: "In the height of farming season, blazing sun without rain—the seasonal order is wrong; this is not without cause.

sentences.zh: 豈朕德薄，刑賞乖中歟？

translations.literal: Is it that my virtue is thin and rewards and punishments miss the mark?
translations.idiomatic: Is it that my virtue is thin and rewards and punishments miss the mark?

sentences.zh: 將公卿大臣或非其人歟？

translations.literal: Or that among the dukes and ministers some are not the right men?
translations.idiomatic: Or that among dukes and ministers some are not the right men?

sentences.zh: 宜盡直言，無得有隱。

translations.literal: You should speak with full candor and hide nothing."
translations.idiomatic: You should speak with full candor and hide nothing."

sentences.zh: 」公卿各引咎自責。

translations.literal: The dukes and ministers each took blame upon themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes and ministers each took blame upon themselves.

sentences.zh: 其夜澍雨。

translations.literal: That night timely rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: That night timely rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，改置宿衛官員。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi, the palace-guard offices were reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on gengzi day, the palace-guard offices were reorganized.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinchou, Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on xinchou day, Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，辰星、太白合於東井。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Mercury and Venus conjoined in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mercury and Venus conjoined in the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 己酉，月犯心中星。

translations.literal: On day jiyou the moon encroached upon the central star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon encroached upon the central star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengzi on the new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the gengzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，扶風掘地得玉杯以獻。

translations.literal: On day gengshen Fufeng dug up a jade cup and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Fufeng dug up a jade cup and presented it.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，上親率六軍講武城南。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu, the sovereign personally led the six armies in martial exercises south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on bingwu day, the emperor personally led the six armies in martial exercises south of the city.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，行幸羌橋，集京城以東諸軍都督以上，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On day gengxu he traveled to Qiang Bridge, gathered army inspector-generals east of the capital and above, and distributed rewards in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he traveled to Qiang Bridge, gathered army inspector-generals from east of the capital upward, and distributed graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On day yimao he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以大司空、趙國公招為大司馬。

translations.literal: On day renxu Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Zhao State Zhao was made grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Grand Minister of Works Yuwen Zhao, Duke of Zhao, was made grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月犯心中星。

translations.literal: On day yiwei the moon encroached upon the central star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon encroached upon the central star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，行幸斜穀，集京城以西諸軍都督已上，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen, he traveled to Xiegu, gathered army inspector-generals west of the capital and above, and distributed rewards in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renshen day, he traveled to Xiegu, gathered army inspector-generals from west of the capital upward, and distributed graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，還宮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝禦正武殿，親錄囚徒，至夜而罷。

translations.literal: On day jichou the Emperor presided at the Hall of Righteous Martialness, personally heard prisoners' cases, and stopped at night.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Emperor Wu presided at the Hall of Righteous Martialness, personally heard prisoners' cases, and stopped only at night.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸道會苑，以上善殿壯麗，遂焚之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin he visited Daohui Park; because the Shanshan Hall was too magnificent, he had it burned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he visited Daohui Park; finding the Shanshan Hall too lavish, he ordered it burned down.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛丑，祠南郊。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day xinchou, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on xinchou day, he offered sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以柱國、鴈門公田弘為大司空，大將軍、徐國公若干鳳為柱國。

translations.literal: On day yisi Pillar-of-State, Duke of Yanmen Tian Hong was made Grand Minister of Works, and Grand General, Duke of Xu Ruogan Feng was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Pillar-of-State Tian Hong, Duke of Yanmen, was made grand minister of works, and Grand General Ruogan Feng, Duke of Xu, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復置帥都督官。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the office of commander-in-chief supervisor was reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the post of commander-in-chief supervisor was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祠太廟。

translations.literal: On day yimao he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yisi, Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yisi day, Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai, a white halo pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on xinhai day, a white halo pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔皇太子贇撫巡西土。

translations.literal: On day jiayin an edict ordered Crown Prince Yun to tour and comfort the western regions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered Crown Prince Yun to tour and reassure the western territories.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣司會侯莫陳凱、太子宮尹鄭譯使於齊。

translations.literal: On day renxu he dispatched Minister of Revenue Houmochen Kai and crown prince household intendant Zheng Yi as envoys to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he sent Minister of Revenue Houmochen Kai and crown prince household intendant Zheng Yi as envoys to Qi.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯輿鬼，入積屍。

translations.literal: Mars entered the Ghost asterism and entered the Corpse Accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Ghost asterism and passed into the Corpse Accumulation.

sentences.zh: 省雍州內八郡，併入京兆、馮翊、扶風、咸陽等郡。

translations.literal: Eight commanderies within Yong Province were abolished and merged into Jingzhao, Fengyi, Fufeng, Xianyang, and other commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Eight commanderies within Yong Province were abolished and merged into Jingzhao, Fengyi, Fufeng, Xianyang, and the like.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，皇太子於岐州獲二白鹿以獻。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao, the crown prince at Qi Province captured two white deer and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on jimao day, the crown prince at Qi Province took two white deer and presented them.

sentences.zh: 詔答曰：「在德不在瑞。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "Virtue matters, not portents.
translations.idiomatic: An edict answered: "What counts is virtue, not auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，省六府諸司中大夫以下官，府置四司，以下大夫為之官長，上士貳之。

translations.literal: " On day guisi offices below assistant grand master in the six ministries were abolished; each ministry was given four departments, with lower grand masters as department heads and senior clerks as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi day posts below assistant grand master in the six ministries were cut; each ministry was given four departments headed by lower grand masters with senior clerks as deputies.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，祠太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jihai day, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，增改東宮官員。

translations.literal: On day bingchen eastern palace officials were added and reformed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day eastern palace staff were expanded and reorganized.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao, Mars violated the Right Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on dingmao day, Mars entered the Right Law-Enforcer asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以柱國周昌公侯莫陳瓊為大宗伯，滎陽公司馬消難為大司寇，上庸公陸騰為大司空。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Pillar-of-State, Duke of Zhouchang Houmochen Qiong was made Grand Director of Ceremonies, Duke of Xingyang Sima Xiaonan was made Grand Minister of Justice, and Duke of Shangyong Lu Teng was made Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Pillar-of-State Houmochen Qiong, Duke of Zhouchang, was made grand director of ceremonies; Sima Xiaonan, Duke of Xingyang, was made grand minister of justice; and Lu Teng, Duke of Shangyong, was made grand minister of works.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，省六府員外諸官，皆為丞。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi, all supernumerary officials in the six ministries were made assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on gengzi day, all supernumerary posts in the six ministries were reduced to assistant rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，月犯心中星。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the moon violated the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon entered the Heart star.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇孫衍生，文武官普加一階。

translations.literal: On day renzi the imperial grandson Yansheng was born; civil and military officials were all promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day imperial grandson Yansheng was born; civil and military officials were all advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 大選諸軍將帥。

translations.literal: A grand selection of army generals and commanders was held.
translations.idiomatic: A grand review selected generals and commanders throughout the armies.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，帝禦露寢，集諸軍將，勖以戎事。

translations.literal: On day bingchen the emperor held court in the exposed dormitory, assembled army generals, and exhorted them on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the emperor held audience in the exposed dormitory, gathered army commanders, and urged them on military matters.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔諸軍旌旗皆畫以猛獸、鷙鳥之象。

translations.literal: On day gengshen an edict ordered all army banners painted with images of fierce beasts and raptor birds.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered every army banner painted with fierce beasts and raptor birds.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，祠太廟。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yisi, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on yisi day, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 自春末不雨，至於是月。

translations.literal: From late spring there had been no rain, continuing until this month.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had failed since late spring and did not come until this month.

sentences.zh: 壬申，集百寮於大德殿，帝責躬罪己，問以治政得失。

translations.literal: On day renshen he gathered the hundred officials in the Hall of Great Virtue; the emperor blamed himself and questioned them on the gains and losses of governance.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he assembled the hundred officials in the Hall of Great Virtue, took blame upon himself, and asked them where rule had succeeded or failed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，雨。

translations.literal: On day wuzi it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day rain fell.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，改三夫人為三妃。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu, the three lady consorts were changed to three consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on bingwu day, the three lady consorts were retitled as three consorts.

sentences.zh: 關內大蝗。

translations.literal: Within the passes there was a great locust plague.
translations.idiomatic: A severe locust plague struck the Guanzhong region.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，陳遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yichou, Chen sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on yichou day, Chen sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Venus violated the Right Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus entered the Right Law-Enforcer asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以柱國、鄭國公達奚震為金州總管。

translations.literal: On day wuyin Pillar-of-State, Duke of Zheng Daxi Zhen was made governor-general of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Pillar-of-State Daxi Zhen, Duke of Zheng, was made governor-general of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「政在節財，禮唯寧儉。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Government rests on frugality; ritual demands quiet simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Rule depends on saving wealth; ritual requires modest restraint.

sentences.zh: 而頃者婚嫁競為奢靡，牢羞之費，罄竭資財，甚乖典訓之理。

translations.literal: Yet lately weddings and funerals have vied in extravagance, and the cost of sacrificial feasts has drained fortunes—this greatly violates canonical teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Yet lately marriages and funerals have grown lavish, and sacrificial feasts have emptied households—this runs far against canonical teaching.

sentences.zh: 有司宜加宣勒，使咸遵禮制。

translations.literal: The relevant offices should enforce this further so that all follow ritual norms.
translations.idiomatic: Offices concerned should press the point so that all observe ritual standards.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，納皇太子妃楊氏。

translations.literal: " On day renwu Crown Princess Yang was welcomed into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu day Crown Princess Yang was received into the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，齊遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day guimao, Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on guimao day, Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，六代樂成，帝御崇信殿，集百官以觀之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen the music of six dynasties was completed; the emperor went to Chongxin Hall and gathered the hundred officials to view it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the music of six dynasties was finished; the emperor went to Chongxin Hall and gathered officials to watch the performance.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，帝親率

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi, the emperor personally led the
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on xinsi day, the emperor personally led the

translations.literal: (grand)
translations.idiomatic: grand

sentences.zh: 軍講武於城東。

translations.literal: army in martial exercises east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: army in martial exercises east of the city.

sentences.zh: 癸未，集諸軍都督以上五十人於道會苑大射，帝親臨射宮，大備軍容。

translations.literal: On day guiwei more than fifty army supervisors and above were gathered at Daohui Park for the great archery contest; the emperor personally attended the archery ground with full military display.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day more than fifty army supervisors and above were assembled at Daohui Park for the great archery contest; the emperor came in person to the archery ground with full military display.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，集羣臣及沙門、道士等，帝升高座，辨釋三教先後，以儒教為先，道教為次，佛教為後。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi, officials, Buddhist monks, and Daoist priests were assembled; the emperor took the high seat and ranked the three teachings—Confucianism first, Daoism second, Buddhism last.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guisi day, officials, Buddhist monks, and Daoist priests were gathered; the emperor took the high seat and ordered the three teachings—Confucianism first, Daoism second, Buddhism last.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、樂川公赫連達為柱國。

translations.literal: Grand General, Duke of Lechuan Helian Da was made pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Helian Da, Duke of Lechuan, was made pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「尊年尚齒，列代弘規，序舊酬勞，哲王明範。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Honoring age and respecting elders is a great rule of successive ages; ordering old merit and rewarding service is a wise king's bright model.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Honoring the aged and respecting elders is a great rule of every age; ordering past service and rewarding merit is a wise king's bright example.

sentences.zh: 朕嗣承弘業，君臨萬邦，驅此兆庶，寘諸仁壽。

translations.literal: I inherit the grand enterprise and rule the myriad realms, guiding this multitude toward benevolent longevity.
translations.idiomatic: I inherit the great enterprise and rule the myriad realms, guiding this multitude toward benevolent longevity.

sentences.zh: 軍民之間，年多耆耋，眷言衰暮，宜有優崇。

translations.literal: Among soldiers and civilians many are elderly; mindful of their declining years, they deserve preferential honor.
translations.idiomatic: Among soldiers and civilians many have reached old age; mindful of their declining years, they deserve special honor.

sentences.zh: 可頒授老職，使榮霑邑里。

translations.literal: Let old-age offices be granted so that honor reaches their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: Let old-age offices be conferred so that honor reaches their home districts.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，聽訟於正武殿，自旦及夜，繼之以燭。

translations.literal: " On day wuwu he heard lawsuits at the Hall of Righteous Martialness from dawn till night, continuing by candlelight.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuwu day he heard cases at the Hall of Righteous Martialness from dawn until night, continuing by candlelight.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬戌，朝羣臣於露門。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day renxu, he held audience with officials at Lumen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, on renxu day, he held court with officials at Lumen Gate.

sentences.zh: 冊柱國齊國公憲、衛國公直、趙國公招、譙國公儉、陳國公純、越國公盛、代國公達、滕國公逌並進爵為王。

translations.literal: Pillars-of-state Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Wei, Yuwen Zhao, Duke of Zhao, Yuwen Jian, Duke of Qiao, Yuwen Chun, Duke of Chen, Yuwen Sheng, Duke of Yue, Yuwen Da, Duke of Dai, and Yuwen You, Duke of Teng, were all promoted to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pillars-of-state Yuwen Xian of Qi, Yuwen Zhi of Wei, Yuwen Zhao of Zhao, Yuwen Jian of Qiao, Yuwen Chun of Chen, Yuwen Sheng of Yue, Yuwen Da of Dai, and Yuwen You of Teng were all advanced to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祠太廟。

translations.literal: On day yisi he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，突厥遣使獻馬。

translations.literal: On day gengwu the Turks sent envoys presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Turks sent envoys with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔：「自今已後，男年十五，女年十三已上，爰及鰥寡，所在軍民，以時嫁娶，務從節儉，勿為財幣稽留。

translations.literal: On day guiyou an edict said: "From now on, men aged fifteen and women thirteen and above, including widowers and widows, soldiers and civilians everywhere should marry in season, keep to frugality, and not delay for dowry wealth.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict said: "Henceforth men of fifteen and women of thirteen and above, including widowers and widows, throughout the armies and the people should marry in season, keep to frugality, and not be held back by dowry wealth.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: " On day yihai he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: " On yihai day he performed the ceremonial plowing at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初服短衣，享二十四軍督將以下，試以軍旅之法，縱酒盡歡。

translations.literal: On day bingzi he first wore short robes, entertained the twenty-four army supervisors and commanders and below, tested them by military methods, and drank freely in full merriment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he first wore short robes, feasted the twenty-four army supervisors and commanders and below, tested them by military drill, and drank freely in full merriment.

sentences.zh: 詔以往歲年穀不登，民多乏絕，令公私道俗，凡有貯積粟麥者，皆准口聽留，以外盡糶。

translations.literal: An edict noted that last year the harvest failed and many people lacked supplies; private and public persons, clergy and laity—all who had stored grain were allowed to keep enough per mouth and must sell the rest.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that because last year's harvest failed and many people were destitute, lay and clerical, public and private—all who had stored grain might keep enough per mouth and must sell the rest.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, first day renchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the renchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，紀國公康、畢國公賢、酆國公貞、宋國公實、漢國公贊、秦國公贄、曹國公允並進爵為王。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Yuwen Kang, Duke of Ji, Yuwen Xian, Duke of Bi, Yuwen Zhen, Duke of Feng, Yuwen Shi, Duke of Song, Yuwen Zan, Duke of Han, Yuwen Yun, Duke of Qin, and Yuwen Yun, Duke of Cao, were all promoted to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yuwen Kang of Ji, Yuwen Xian of Bi, Yuwen Zhen of Feng, Yuwen Shi of Song, Yuwen Zan of Han, Yuwen Yun of Qin, and Yuwen Yun of Cao were all advanced to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 丙午，令六府各舉賢良清正之人。

translations.literal: On day bingwu each of the six ministries was ordered to recommend upright and worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day each of the six ministries was ordered to recommend worthy and upright men.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，柱國、許國公宇文善有罪免。

translations.literal: On day guichou Pillar-of-State, Duke of Xu Yuwen Shan was guilty and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Shan, Duke of Xu, was found guilty and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，行幸雲陽宮。

translations.literal: On day yimao he traveled to Yunyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he went to Yunyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「民生而靜，純懿之性本均；

translations.literal: An edict said: "People are born quiet; pure and good nature is originally equal for all;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "People are born in quiet; pure and upright nature is originally the same for all;

sentences.zh: 感物而遷，嗜欲之情斯起。

translations.literal: touched by things they change, and passionate desire then arises.
translations.idiomatic: touched by things they shift, and craving then arises.

sentences.zh: 雖復雲鳥殊世，文質異時，莫不限以堤防，示之禁令。

translations.literal: Though cloud-and-bird ages differ and wen and zhi times vary, none fails to set dikes and levees and show prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Though the age of cloud-and-bird omen and the age of pattern differ, none fails to set limits and show prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 朕君臨萬宇，覆養黎元，思振頹綱，納之軌式。

translations.literal: I rule the ten thousand realms, sheltering the people, seeking to revive the collapsed order and bring them into proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: I rule the ten thousand realms, sheltering the people, seeking to revive the fallen order and bring them into proper form.

sentences.zh: 比因人有犯，與衆棄之，所在羣官有愆過者，咸聽首露，莫不輕重畢陳，纖毫無隱。

translations.literal: Recently because people committed offenses they were abandoned by the multitude; wherever officials had faults, all were allowed to confess first, none failing to disclose light and heavy matters without hiding the slightest.
translations.idiomatic: Lately because people had offended they were cast out by the crowd; wherever officials had transgressions, all were allowed to confess first, none failing to lay out light and heavy matters without hiding the least detail.

sentences.zh: 斯則風行草偃，從化無違，導德齊禮，庶幾可致。

translations.literal: Thus wind blows and grass bends; following transformation none disobey—guiding by virtue and equalizing by ritual may nearly be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Then wind blows and grass bends; following transformation none resist—guiding by virtue and aligning by ritual may nearly be reached.

sentences.zh: 但上失其道，有自來矣，淩夷之弊，反本無由，宜加蕩滌，與民更始。

translations.literal: But when superiors lose the Way it has long been so; the ruin of decline offers no return to the root—we should wash it clean and begin anew with the people.
translations.idiomatic: But when those above lose the Way it has long been so; the damage of decline leaves no path back to the root—we should wash it away and begin anew with the people.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，皇太后不豫。

translations.literal: On day gengshen the empress dowager fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the empress dowager fell ill.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，至自雲陽宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou, he returned from Yunyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on xinyou day, he returned from Yunyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇太后叱奴氏崩。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Empress Dowager Chinu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Empress Dowager Chinu died.

sentences.zh: 帝居倚廬，朝夕共一溢米。

translations.literal: The emperor lived in a mourning hut, eating only one cup of rice morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor lived in a mourning hut, taking only one cup of rice morning and evening.

sentences.zh: 羣臣表請，累旬乃止。

translations.literal: Officials submitted memorials pleading; only after many days did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: Officials submitted memorials pleading with him; only after many days did he desist.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太子贇總釐庶政。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Crown Prince Yun to oversee all ordinary government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Crown Prince Yun to take charge of ordinary government.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，齊遣使弔贈會葬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao, Qi sent envoys to offer condolences and gifts for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, Qi sent envoys to offer condolences and funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，有星孛於東北紫宮垣，長七尺。

translations.literal: On day dingsi a broom star appeared in the northeast Purple Palace wall, seven feet long.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day a broom star appeared in the northeast Purple Palace wall, seven feet in length.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，葬文宣皇后於永固陵，帝袒跣至陵所。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen, Empress Wenxuan was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum; the emperor went barefoot and bare-chested to the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on gengshen day, Empress Wenxuan was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum; the emperor went to the tomb barefoot and bare-chested.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔曰：「齊斬之情，經籍彝訓，近代沿革，遂亡斯禮。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The feeling proper to qi-and-zhan mourning is set forth in the classics and canonical instruction; through recent reforms that rite has perished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The grief proper to qi-and-zhan mourning is set forth in the classics and canonical teaching; through recent reforms that rite has been lost.

sentences.zh: 伏奉遺令，旣葬便除，攀慕几筵，情實未忍。

translations.literal: I humbly received her final command to end mourning once burial was done, but my longing for her beside the mourning mat—I truly cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly received her final command to end mourning once burial was done, yet my longing for her beside the mourning mat—I truly cannot bear it.

sentences.zh: 三年之喪，達於天子，古今無易之道，王者之所常行。

translations.literal: Three-year mourning extends even to the Son of Heaven—it is the unchanging way of antiquity and present alike, what kings routinely perform.
translations.idiomatic: Three-year mourning extends even to the Son of Heaven—it is the unchanging way of past and present alike, what kings routinely perform.

sentences.zh: 但時有未諧，不得全制。

translations.literal: But the times are not suited, and the complete rite cannot be kept.
translations.idiomatic: But the times are not suited, and the full rite cannot be kept.

sentences.zh: 軍國務重，庶自聽朝。

translations.literal: Military and state affairs weigh heavily; I shall still hold audience for ordinary business.
translations.idiomatic: Military and state affairs weigh heavily; I shall still hold audience myself.

sentences.zh: 縗麻之節，苫廬之禮，率遵前典，以申罔極。

translations.literal: The hemp-garment observances and hut-mourning rites will wholly follow former canon to express boundless grief.
translations.idiomatic: The hemp-garment observances and hut-mourning rites will wholly follow former canon to express boundless grief.

sentences.zh: 百寮以下，宜依遺令。

translations.literal: Officials below should follow the final command.
translations.idiomatic: Officials below should follow the final command.

sentences.zh: 」公卿上表，固請俯就權制，過葬卽吉。

translations.literal: " The high ministers memorialized, firmly asking him to accept provisional rites and end mourning right after burial.
translations.idiomatic: " The high ministers memorialized, firmly asking him to accept provisional rites and end mourning immediately after burial.

sentences.zh: 帝不許，引古禮答之，羣臣乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor refused and cited ancient ritual in reply; the officials then desisted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused and answered with ancient ritual; the officials then desisted.

sentences.zh: 於是遂申三年之制，五服之內，亦令依禮。

translations.literal: Thereupon he observed the three-year mourning system; within the five degrees of mourning he also ordered compliance with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he observed the three-year mourning system; within the five degrees of kin he also ordered compliance with ritual.

sentences.zh: 初置太子諫議員四人，文學十人；

translations.literal: At first four crown prince remonstrance officers and ten literary scholars were appointed;
translations.idiomatic: At first four crown prince remonstrance officers and ten literary scholars were appointed;

sentences.zh: 皇弟、皇子友員各二人，學士六人。

translations.literal: imperial brothers and princes each received two friend-officers and six scholars.
translations.idiomatic: imperial brothers and princes each received two friend-officers and six scholars.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，荊州獻白烏。

translations.literal: On day dingmao Jing Province presented a white crow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Jing Province presented a white crow.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔故晉國公護及諸子，並追復先封，改葬加諡。

translations.literal: On day wuchen an edict restored the former enfeoffments of the late Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu and his sons, reburied them, and added posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict restored the former enfeoffments of the late Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu and his sons, reburied them, and added posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初斷佛、道二教，經像悉毀，罷沙門、道士，並令還民。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Buddhism and Daoism were first proscribed; scriptures and images were all destroyed; monks and Daoist priests were dismissed and ordered to return to lay life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Buddhism and Daoism were first proscribed; scriptures and images were all destroyed; monks and Daoist priests were dismissed and ordered back to lay life.

sentences.zh: 並禁諸淫祀，禮典所不載者，盡除之。

translations.literal: All licentious sacrifices not recorded in canonical ritual were also banned and removed.
translations.idiomatic: All improper sacrifices not recorded in canonical ritual were also banned and abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，集諸軍將，教以戰陣之法。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei, army generals were assembled and taught battle formations.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on dingwei day, army generals were assembled and instructed in battle formations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，更鑄五行大布錢，以一當十，與布泉錢並行。

translations.literal: On day renzi the five-element great spade coin was recast, valued at ten, and circulated alongside cloth-spade coins.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the five-element great spade coin was recast, valued at ten, and circulated together with cloth-spade coins.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔曰：「至道弘深，混成無際，體包空有，理極幽玄。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The supreme Way is vast and deep, blended and boundless; it embraces emptiness and existence and reaches to the utmost of dark mystery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The supreme Way is vast and deep, blended and boundless; it embraces emptiness and existence and reaches to the utmost of dark mystery.

sentences.zh: 但岐路旣分，派源逾遠，淳離樸散，形氣斯乖。

translations.literal: But when paths divided, sources grew remote; plainness departed and simplicity scattered—the form and spirit grew estranged.
translations.idiomatic: But when paths divided, sources grew remote; plainness departed and simplicity scattered—the form and spirit grew estranged.

sentences.zh: 遂使三墨八儒，朱紫交競；

translations.literal: Thus three Mohists and eight Confucians, vermilion and purple vying together;
translations.idiomatic: Thus three Mohists and eight Confucians, vermilion and purple vying together;

sentences.zh: 九流七略，異說相騰。

translations.literal: the nine streams and seven summaries, rival doctrines contending;
translations.idiomatic: the nine streams and seven summaries, rival doctrines contending;

sentences.zh: 道隱小成，其來舊矣。

translations.literal: the Way has hidden its small completions—this is old indeed.
translations.idiomatic: the Way has hidden its small completions—this is old indeed.

sentences.zh: 不有會歸，爭驅靡息。

translations.literal: Without a gathering center, the race of contention never ceases.
translations.idiomatic: Without a gathering center, the race of contention never ceases.

sentences.zh: 今可立信道觀，聖哲微言，先賢典訓，金科玉篆，秘跡玄文，所以濟養黎元，扶成教義者，並宜弘闡，一以貫之。

translations.literal: Now let a Platform for Establishing the Way be founded; sage subtle sayings, worthy ancestors' canonical teachings, golden precepts and jade inscriptions, secret traces and dark texts—all that nourishes the people and supports the teaching should be broadly expounded and threaded as one.
translations.idiomatic: Now let a Platform for Establishing the Way be founded; sage subtle sayings, worthy ancestors' canonical teachings, golden precepts and jade inscriptions, secret traces and dark texts—all that nourishes the people and supports the teaching should be broadly expounded and threaded as one.

sentences.zh: 俾夫翫培塿者，識嵩岱之崇崛；

translations.literal: So that those who toy with anthills may know Song and Tai's towering rise;
translations.idiomatic: So that those who toy with anthills may know Song and Tai's towering rise;

sentences.zh: 守磧礫者，悟渤澥之泓澄，不亦可乎。」

translations.literal: and those who cling to gravel may grasp the Bohai's deep clarity—is this not fitting?"
translations.idiomatic: and those who cling to gravel may grasp the Bohai's deep clarity—is this not fitting?"

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，行幸雲陽宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengshen, he traveled to Yunyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on gengshen day, he went to Yunyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，衛王直在京師舉兵反，欲突入肅章門。

translations.literal: On day yiyou Prince of Wei Yuwen Zhi raised troops in revolt at the capital, intending to burst through the Suo and Zhang gates.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince of Wei Yuwen Zhi raised troops in revolt at the capital, intending to force his way through the Suo and Zhang gates.

sentences.zh: 司武尉遲運等拒守。

translations.literal: Director of Martial Affairs Yuchi Yun and others held them off.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Martial Affairs Yuchi Yun and others held them off.

sentences.zh: 直敗，率百餘騎遁走。

translations.literal: Zhi was defeated and fled with more than a hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi was defeated and fled with more than a hundred horsemen.

sentences.zh: 京師連雨三旬，是日霽。

translations.literal: The capital had rained for thirty days; that day it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The capital had rained for thirty days; that day it cleared.

sentences.zh: 戊子，至自雲陽宮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi he returned from Yunyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he returned from Yunyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，擒直於荊州，免為庶人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao, Zhi was captured at Jing Province and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on xinmao day, Zhi was captured at Jing Province and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔自建德元年八月以前犯罪，未被推糾，於後事發失官爵者，並聽復舊。

translations.literal: On day yiwei an edict said that crimes before the eighth month of the first Jiande year that were not investigated and for which office or rank was later lost when the facts came out should all be allowed restoration.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict said that for crimes before the eighth month of the first Jiande year that had not been pursued, and for which office or rank was later lost when the facts emerged, restoration should be allowed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，行幸雲陽宮。

translations.literal: On day bingshen he traveled to Yunyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he went to Yunyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，幸同州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen, he visited Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengshen day, he visited Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以柱國、大宗伯、周昌公侯莫陳瓊為秦州總管。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Pillar-of-State, Grand Director of Ceremonies, Duke of Zhouchang Houmochen Qiong was made governor-general of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Pillar-of-State Houmochen Qiong, Duke of Zhouchang and grand director of ceremonies, was made governor-general of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，御正楊尚希、禮部盧愷使於陳。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day bingshen, Imperial Rectifier Yang Shangxi and Minister of Rites Lu Kai were sent as envoys to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on bingshen day, Imperial Rectifier Yang Shangxi and Minister of Rites Lu Kai were sent as envoys to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雍州獻蒼烏。

translations.literal: On day wuxu Yong Province presented a dark crow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Yong Province presented a dark crow.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔蒲州民遭饑乏絕者，令向郿城以西，及荊州管內就食。

translations.literal: On day gengzi an edict said that people of Pu Province suffering famine should be allowed to seek food west of Meicheng and within Jing Province's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict said that people of Pu Province suffering famine should be allowed to seek food west of Meicheng and within Jing Province's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，行幸蒲州。

translations.literal: On day jiayin he traveled to Pu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he went to Pu Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，曲赦蒲州見囚大辟以下。

translations.literal: On day yimao a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners then held in Pu Province down to capital offenses.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners then held in Pu Province down to capital offenses.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，行幸同州。

translations.literal: On day bingchen he traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day he went to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 始州民王鞅擁衆反，大將軍鄭恪討平之。

translations.literal: Wang Yang of Shi Province gathered a crowd in revolt; Grand General Zheng Ke suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yang of Shi Province gathered a crowd in revolt; Grand General Zheng Ke suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，以柱國、大司空、上庸公陸騰為涇州總管。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, Pillar-of-State, Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Shangyong Lu Teng was made governor-general of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on wuwu day, Pillar-of-State Lu Teng, Duke of Shangyong and grand minister of works, was made governor-general of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 于闐遣使獻名馬。

translations.literal: Khotan sent envoys presenting famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan sent envoys presenting famous horses.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大閱於城東。

translations.literal: On day yisi a grand review was held east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day a grand review was held east of the city.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自同州。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu he returned from Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he returned from Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，大會衛官及軍人以上，賜錢帛各有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi, guard officers and soldiers and above were gathered in great assembly and given money and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on wuzi day, guard officers and soldiers and above were gathered in great assembly and given money and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，月掩太白。

translations.literal: On day xinmao the moon eclipsed Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon eclipsed Venus.

sentences.zh: 詔荊、襄、安、延、夏五州總管內，有能率其從軍者，授官各有差。

translations.literal: An edict said that within the five governor-generals of Jing, Xiang, An, Yan, and Xia, those who could lead followers into military service would receive offices in graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that within the five governor-generals of Jing, Xiang, An, Yan, and Xia, those who could lead followers into military service would receive offices in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 其貧下戶，給復三年。

translations.literal: Poor households would receive three years' tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households would receive three years' tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 丙申，改諸軍軍士並為侍官。

translations.literal: On day bingshen all army soldiers were retitled as attendant officers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day all army soldiers were retitled as attendant officers.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，利州上言騶虞見。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Li Province reported a zouyu sighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Li Province reported a zouyu sighting.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，集諸軍講武於臨皋澤。

translations.literal: On day guimao all armies were assembled for martial exercises at Lingao Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day all armies were assembled for martial exercises at Lingao Marsh.

sentences.zh: 涼州比年地震，壞城郭，地裂，湧泉出。

translations.literal: In Liang Province earthquakes had occurred year after year, ruining walls and gates; the earth split and springs gushed forth.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang Province earthquakes had occurred year after year, ruining walls and gates; the earth split and springs gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七一年十一月版《周書》為本校。

translations.literal: The entire text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Zhou, November 1971.
translations.idiomatic: The entire text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Zhou, November 1971.
